title: Customer Support & Fulfillment Operations Lead
description:
Customer Support & Fulfillment Team Lead



About the role



We are a direct-to-consumer supplement brand serving customers worldwide, with most of our customers based in the United States. We are looking for an experienced Customer Support & Fulfillment Team Lead to oversee our customer support operation and monitor the accuracy and performance of our fulfillment processes.



You will lead the Customer Support team, make sure our SOPs are followed, and ensure customer and operational issues are handled accurately and promptly. You will also oversee payment disputes and work closely with Fulfillment and Management to identify recurring problems and improve our processes.



This is a hands-on role combining team leadership, quality control, operational oversight, and reporting.





 Key responsibilities



Core responsibilities



- Manage and support the Customer Support team in its daily work.

- Review customer conversations regularly and coach agents on quality, accuracy, tone, and SOP compliance.

- Ensure customers receive timely responses and that urgent, sensitive, or high-risk cases are prioritized.

- Monitor fulfillment cases, including order errors, replacements, address changes, shipping delays, lost packages, and tracking exceptions.

- Coordinate clearly and promptly between Customer Support, Fulfillment, Management, and other teams.

- Manage and oversee PayPal disputes, Shopify chargebacks, and other payment-related cases.

- Take ownership of escalated issues and follow them through to resolution.

- Maintain and improve SOPs as policies, tools, and workflows change.



 Reporting and process improvement



- Prepare regular KPI reports for Management, covering ticket volume, response and resolution times, customer satisfaction, refunds, cancellation reasons, disputes, and fulfillment issues.

- Identify patterns in customer complaints, operational errors, and team performance.

- Recommend and help implement improvements to workflows, SOPs, customer experience, and fulfillment coordination.

- Escalate critical issues and recurring risks with clear context and recommended next steps.



Required experience and skills



- Previous experience as a Customer Support Team Lead, Customer Experience Manager, Operations Manager, or in a similar role, preferably in e-commerce.

- Experience leading or coordinating remote customer support teams.

- Hands-on experience with Shopify, including orders, customer accounts, refunds, cancellations, fulfillment statuses, and chargebacks.

- Experience with subscription-based e-commerce and platforms such as Loop Subscriptions or similar tools.

- Strong understanding of subscription workflows, including cancellations, skips, pauses, frequency changes, rebills, retention offers, and subscription-related complaints.

- Experience handling PayPal disputes and Shopify chargebacks, with an understanding of dispute prevention and chargeback reduction.

- Experience working with fulfillment centers, 3PLs, warehouses, or international fulfillment partners.

- Ability to investigate tracking issues, shipping exceptions, lost packages, replacement requests, address problems, and fulfillment errors.

- Experience defining, monitoring, and reporting Customer Support KPIs.

- Strong quality-control, auditing, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Experience writing, improving, and enforcing SOPs.

- Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required, as most of our customers are based in the United States.

- Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

- Ability to make sound decisions independently and take ownership of issues through resolution.



Helpful additional experience



- Experience in the supplements, health, or wellness industry.

- Experience supporting customers with product-related concerns and escalating potential safety issues appropriately.

- Familiarity with customer support platforms, subscription tools, and reporting dashboards.

- German language skills are a plus.



A quick note for applicants



To confirm that you have read the full job description, begin your application with the word TRACK.

title: Canva + AI Design & Personalization Virtual Assistant for Etsy Shop — Part Time
description:
I am looking for a creative, highly detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help with design production and customer personalization for my established Etsy business.



This is a **part-time, long-term position working approximately 2 hours per day, Monday through Friday (10 hours per week).**



The position will have **two primary responsibilities: scaling existing product designs into additional niches and personalizing customer orders using my existing Canva templates.**



I am looking for someone who is consistently available Monday–Friday and would like to grow with the business over time.



### RESPONSIBILITY #1 — SCALE EXISTING DESIGNS



I will provide approved designs, Canva templates, niche lists, examples, and instructions. Your job will be to take successful design concepts and adapt them into additional niches while maintaining the same overall style and quality.



This may include:



- Creating new variations from existing Canva templates

- Scaling designs into different professions, hobbies, sports, interests, and other niches

- Using AI tools to create or modify artwork when needed

- Changing artwork, text, colors, and other design elements while maintaining the original design style

- Creating designs for products such as ornaments and apparel

- Exporting artwork in the correct size and format

- Following established file-naming and organization systems

- Tracking completed designs in shared spreadsheets



For example, I may provide an approved ornament design, a Canva template, instructions, and a spreadsheet containing a list of professions. You would use that system to create coordinated versions for the different professions.



### RESPONSIBILITY #2 — PERSONALIZE CUSTOMER ORDERS



You will also help prepare personalized customer orders for production.



I will provide the order information and a link to the appropriate Canva template. You will:



- Open the correct Canva template

- Carefully review the customer's personalization information

- Add the customer's requested name, year, date, wording, colors, or other personalization

- Double-check all spelling, numbers, dates, and other details against the original order information

- Make sure the design follows the provided template and instructions

- Download the completed production-ready file in the required format

- Add the completed file or file link to the appropriate location in my order-tracking spreadsheet

- Clearly mark the order as completed according to my workflow



**Accuracy is extremely important for this part of the position.** Personalized products are created specifically for each customer, so names, dates, years, spelling, colors, and other order details must be entered exactly as provided.



Training and step-by-step instructions will be provided for this process.



### ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES AS THE POSITION GROWS



Once you become familiar with our products and systems, there may be opportunities to help with:



- Product mockups

- Listing images

- Customer proofs

- Additional production preparation

- Organizing Canva templates and design files

- Other Etsy production and design tasks



### IDEAL CANDIDATE



You may be a great fit if you:



- Are highly proficient with Canva

- Have experience using AI image-generation/design tools

- Have a good eye for layout, typography and color

- Can closely follow an existing design style

- Have **excellent attention to detail**

- Are especially careful with names, spelling, dates and numbers

- Are comfortable doing repetitive design-production work

- Work efficiently without sacrificing accuracy

- Are organized with files, spreadsheets and naming conventions

- Can follow written workflows and instructions

- Communicate clearly

- Are dependable and able to meet deadlines

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

- Are consistently available to work approximately **2 hours each weekday, Monday through Friday**



Experience with Etsy, print-on-demand, personalized products, ornaments, or apparel is helpful but **not required**.



### HOURS & PAY



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday  

**Hours:** Approximately 2 hours per day / 10 hours per week  

**Starting Pay:** $5 USD/hour



I am specifically looking for someone who can work consistently throughout the week rather than completing all 10 hours on one or two days.



There may be opportunities for **additional hours during busy seasons**, as well as increased responsibilities and compensation for the right person.



### PAID DESIGN TEST



Selected finalists will be invited to complete a **one-hour PAID skills test**.



The test will include sample Canva templates and instructions similar to the work you would perform in this position.



I will be evaluating:



- Quality of work

- Attention to detail

- Ability to follow instructions

- Accuracy

- Canva skills

- Organization

- Work completed within the allotted time



You will be paid for the test regardless of how much you complete.



### HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following:



1. A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

2. Examples of **3–5 designs you personally created**, preferably using Canva.

3. Which AI image-generation or design tools you have experience using.

4. An example of working from an existing template or established design style.

5. Whether you are comfortable taking one approved design and adapting it into many different niches.

6. Tell me about any experience you have personalizing products or working with customer order information.

7. Your requested hourly rate in USD.

8. Confirm that you are available approximately **2 hours per day, Monday through Friday**.

9. Let me know whether you currently have another full-time job or ongoing VA clients.

10. Tell me what computer you use and whether you have reliable internet access.

11. If I gave you a Canva template, written instructions, and a spreadsheet containing 30 professions, briefly explain how you would approach and organize the project.



**Important:** At the very end of your application, please write the words **“Watercolor Ornament.”**



I am looking for someone who would like to grow into a long-term role with my business. If you are creative, organized, efficient, extremely detail-oriented, and enjoy both design work and structured production tasks, I would love to hear from you.

description:

- Call property owners using a power dialer and our script

- Update lead status, notes and follow-up date in our CRM after every call

title: Senior Amazon Brand Manager – UK, Europe & USA
description:
MTL Global is a UK-based e-commerce business operating established consumer brands across Amazon and other major online marketplaces.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Amazon Brand Manager to take ownership of the growth and day-to-day management  our fast-growing household and laundry brand.



Brand is already trading in the UK and is expanding internationally across Europe and the United States.



This is not a junior Amazon VA position.



We are looking for someone who already knows Amazon extremely well, has personally managed successful private-label or consumer-product brands and can work independently without requiring extensive training.

You will work directly with the Managing Director and our existing PPC/creative resources.



Your responsibility

Your job is simple:

Grow the Brand on Amazon profitably across the UK, Europe and USA.

You will take ownership of the Amazon channel rather than simply complete tasks assigned to you.



Key responsibilities

Amazon Seller Central

- Full day-to-day management of Amazon Seller Central

- UK, European and US marketplaces

- Account health monitoring

- Brand Registry

- Listing and catalogue troubleshooting

- Variations and parent/child structures

- Flat-file uploads and bulk updates

- Seller Support cases and escalations

- Suppressed listings and compliance issues

- FBA inventory monitoring

Listings & Conversion

- Keyword research

- Amazon SEO

- Titles, bullets and backend search terms

- Listing optimisation

- Competitor analysis

- Conversion-rate improvement

- A/B testing

- Manage A+ and Premium A+ content

- Amazon Store management

- Coordinate image and video improvements with our creative team

You do not need to personally design graphics, but you must be able to identify what creative is required and brief designers properly.

Brand Growth

- Develop marketplace growth plans

- New-product launches

- Promotional planning

- Coupons and deals

- Subscribe & Save development

- Review and rating strategy within Amazon policy

- Organic ranking improvement

- Competitive positioning

- Cross-selling opportunities

- Product opportunity analysis

- International marketplace expansion

Advertising

We have separate PPC resources, but you must understand Amazon Advertising sufficiently to:

- Review PPC performance

- Understand ACOS and TACOS

- Identify inefficient spend

- Analyse search terms

- Understand organic versus paid ranking

- Challenge PPC strategy where appropriate

- Work with the PPC specialist to improve profitable growth

Commercial Performance

You will be expected to understand the economics behind Amazon, including:

- Revenue

- Gross margin

- Amazon fees

- FBA fees

- Advertising spend

- ACOS

- TACOS

- Conversion rate

- Sessions

- CTR

- Contribution margin

- Inventory

- Subscribe & Save

- Repeat purchase performance

We are interested in profitable growth, not vanity revenue.

International experience



You must have hands-on Amazon experience.

Experience managing more than one of the following is strongly preferred:

- Amazon UK

- Amazon USA

- Amazon Germany

- Amazon France

- Amazon Italy

- Amazon Spain

Experience with European Amazon marketplaces, Pan-EU/FBA or international expansion is a significant advantage.

Required experience

Please do not apply if you are learning Amazon or primarily have general VA experience.

We are looking for:

- Minimum 4 years hands-on Amazon experience

- Proven management of private-label or consumer-product brands

- Strong Seller Central knowledge

- Evidence that you have personally helped grow Amazon revenue

- Strong Amazon SEO and listing optimisation knowledge

- Strong commercial and analytical ability

- Understanding of Amazon PPC

- Advanced Excel/Google Sheets competence

- Excellent written English

- Ability to work independently

- Strong problem-solving ability

- High attention to detail

Household, FMCG, beauty, supplements, consumables or other repeat-purchase consumer-product experience would be particularly valuable.

What we DON'T need

We do not need someone who:

- Requires step-by-step instructions

- Has only completed an Amazon course

- Primarily works as a general VA

- Has only managed listings

- Only understands PPC

- Needs us to teach them Seller Central

- Waits for management to identify every problem

We want somebody who can look at an account, identify opportunities and problems themselves and take ownership.

title: Video editor
description:
We are Bob and Gina Struwe, a two-person real estate team in Utah (Struwe Realty Group, Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices). We are starting a YouTube channel built around our residential listings, and we are looking for a reliable editor and thumbnail designer for ongoing work.



WHAT YOU WOULD DO

- Edit one long-form YouTube video per listing from our raw walk-through video, a spoken script, professional photos, and music.

- Match the style of our finished overview video, which we will send you as the example.

- Cut 3 to 5 vertical Shorts (under 60 seconds) from each long-form video, with captions.

- Clean up audio, trim dead air and mistakes, and add titles, captions, and simple transitions.

- Design a YouTube thumbnail for each long-form video (1280x720), with 2 options per video so we can pick one. Use our professional photos, large readable text of 3 to 5 words, and our brand colors, and keep the look consistent across listings.

- Deliver files in YouTube and Shorts formats.



WHAT WE WILL SEND YOU

- Raw walk-through video, the script, and the professional photos

- Our overview video as a style example

- Our logo, brand colors, and a thumbnail style example

- The listing price and address details for thumbnail text



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Real experience editing YouTube videos, preferably real estate or property tours

- Skill in Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut

- Thumbnail design skill in Photoshop, Canva, or similar

- Good written English so you can follow instructions

- A reliable internet connection and a turnaround of 48 hours or less



HOW TO APPLY

Please reply with:

1. Two or three samples of real estate or YouTube edits

2. Two or three thumbnail samples

3. Your rate per finished video (long-form, Shorts, and thumbnails)

4. Your typical turnaround time



We will pay for one test video. If it goes well, we will move to ongoing work.

title: Content Creator & Storyteller – Sydney Exterior Cleaning | 20 hrs/wk, Full-Time up to US$12/hr
description:
G'day! We're Sweet Home Exterior Cleaning, a pressure cleaning and soft washing company in Sydney, Australia. We clean houses, roofs, driveways and building exteriors, and our crews film everything.



Every day our technicians shoot photos and videos on their iPhones, and everything uploads automatically to a shared iPhone library. We have HUNDREDS of unpublished clips and long raw videos, all REAL jobs with REAL people. No AI, no stock footage.



We're looking for a Content Creator & Storyteller to become the backbone of our content: someone who finds the story in the footage and posts it every day.



THE FEELING

Real, raw and human. Think "a day on the tools with mates" rather than "TV commercial". The dirt, the early starts, the tired roof that's been ignored for 20 years, the customer who can't believe it's the same house. Real and a bit rough beats polished and fake.



We do NOT want over-produced videos, fancy motion graphics or corporate-looking edits. We DO want fast cuts, strong hooks, natural captions and stories that make people feel something.



We're chasing VOLUME first, then quality. We'd rather post 5 good videos today than 1 perfect video this week.



THE TWO FORMATS WE NEED

1. Quick clips (7–20 seconds): satisfying cleans, reveals, close-ups. Several every day.

2. Story videos (60 seconds to 3+ minutes): a person, a problem, a transformation, a reaction. For example: "This house was about to be repainted for $40,000…", "Phil's first roof in the rain", "She hadn't seen her driveway this colour in 15 years."



One job should become at least 5 pieces of content.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Go through our shared iPhone library (new uploads every day plus a big backlog) and turn it into Reels, TikToks, Shorts and carousels

- Post daily on Instagram, TikTok,
 and YouTube Shorts (long-form YouTube and Google Business Profile later)

- Start at 2–3 posts per half-day session and build up to around 5 per session

- Spot trends, formats and sounds on TikTok and Instagram that we can adapt

- Write hooks, captions and on-screen text that sound natural and Australian

- Make our team (Danco the founder, Paulo, Phil) and our customers the recurring characters in our stories

- Ask us for what you need (e.g. "Danco, record a 5-second hook to camera saying X")

- Keep a weekly content calendar and review the numbers with us every week. We'll decide together what to do more of.



HOW YOUR WEEK LOOKS (20 hrs)

- 4 posting sessions (about 4 hrs each): edit, create, post

- 1 strategy session (about 4 hrs): review what worked, research trends, plan next week, send shot requests to the team

- About 80% from existing footage, 20% new creative ideas



YOU MUST HAVE

- An iPhone. Our photos and videos sync through an iPhone Shared Library, so you need one to access and edit them (any computer is fine as well)

- Strong CapCut skills (Canva is a plus)

- Proof you've made content that gets views: links + screenshots of views, reach or follower growth

- Experience creating content for businesses

- Strong storytelling and good written English

- The ability to work fast and independently. You won't be told what to do every day.

- Reliable internet for uploading lots of video



BIG BONUS IF YOU

- Have worked with Australian clients or understand Aussie humour and slang

- Have created content for trades or home-service businesses (cleaning, roofing, plumbing, landscaping, real estate)

- Have grown a TikTok or Instagram account from scratch



HARD RULES

- Never post a customer's house number, street sign or number plate

- The first 2 seconds must have a hook. No slow intros, no logo intros.



PAY AND GROWTH

- Start: US$5–7/hr for 20 hrs/week, depending on proof of results

- Full-time: US$10–12/hr once you've consistently hit your posting targets and we see the numbers growing

- Long term: you lead the content side of the business as we grow



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with "SWEET HOME STORYTELLER". Applications without it won't be read. Then send:



1. A short intro and your available hours (Philippine time)

2. Links to 3–5 videos you created, with screenshots of views or results

3. Businesses or accounts you've made content for (any in Australia?)

4. STORY TEST: "A crew spends 6 hours cleaning a black, mouldy roof in Sydney. The owner is 78 and has lived there 40 years." Give us 3 hooks (the first 2 seconds) AND a 3-sentence outline of the story video you'd make.

5. GUT CHECK: "It's Friday afternoon, you've posted 2 of your 5 videos, and the new uploads are all blurry. What do you do?" (One or two sentences.)

6. Your expected hourly rate (USD)



TRIAL

Shortlisted applicants do a short trial with our real footage. If you can show proof of past results, the trial is PAID. If you're newer and can't show proof yet, you'll do a short free test (about 1 hour). We never post free test work.



We read every application personally. If you love making content that feels real and tells a story, we want to hear from you!

title: Client Support Concierge

The Client Support Concierge is the frontline of the CAASie client experience. This role sits at the centre of the business;  you are the first person a client hears from, and the person responsible for making sure their query is resolved, not just acknowledged. 



You will own enquiries from first contact through to resolution, with no handoffs and no drop-offs. - An eye for patterns and process - you notice when something keeps coming up and you do something about it

s from their account, and the cat is very upset about the service. Reply to the cat in two or three sentences, and have fun with it.

Prospecting and outreach to fashion brands who'd benefit from the platform (mostly calls will be booked via ads for you). Running live demos via Google Meet, handling objections, and closing deals. Managing email communication with prospects and clients throughout the sales cycle and beyond — you'll need to stay on top of threads, follow up promptly, and keep conversations moving as deal cycles can take 14-30 days. Onboarding new clients you've sold — training them on the platform so they get value fast. Managing ongoing client relationships to reduce churn and identify upsell opportunities. Keeping the CRM updated with pipeline activity, deal stages, and client notes — if it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen. You'll be trained on the product — you don't need to know it already. But you do need to be someone who takes ownership of a number and finds ways to hit it.



Requirements

Native or near-native American English is non-negotiable. You'll be on calls with US-based brand owners and need to communicate clearly and confidently. Proven track record in sales — you've carried a quota before and can talk about how you hit it. Strong written communication — a big part of this role is email. title: E-commerce Operations Specialist — Amazon, Shopify & Customer Experience
description:
HoppScotch is an established rabbit-products e-commerce brand. We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented E-commerce Operations Specialist to help run Amazon and Shopify operations, keep orders and inventory accurate, support customers, and research useful new products.



This is a hands-on operations role, not a general assistant or entry-level training position. You will work with the founder and a dedicated marketing teammate;
 campaigns and ongoing social content are not your primary responsibility.



ROLE AND COMPENSATION

• Remote, long-term opportunity, starting at 25 paid hours per week.

• Starting rate: $7.50 USD per hour, paid weekly through Remitly.

• Initial schedule: Monday–Friday, 3:00–8:00 p.m. California time (America/Los_Angeles). Please account for daylight-saving changes in your local time.

• Shortlisted finalists may be invited to a 15-hour paid trial at the same rate. Authorized onboarding, research, meetings, and documentation count toward those hours.

• Any later increase in hours or rate requires a separate agreement; it is not automatic.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Amazon Seller Central: monitor account health and policy notices, investigate issues, prepare evidence-based resolutions, manage listings and inventory information, and respond to customer questions.

• Shopify operations: maintain products and variants, check inventory locations and stock availability, investigate overselling or order discrepancies, and improve routine store operations.

• Fulfillment: trace orders and inventory across Shopify and Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF), prevent duplicate fulfillment, and verify order status before communicating with customers.

• Customer support: review
 and authorized social/message queues, organize outstanding issues, and prepare clear, accurate responses using approved policies.

• Supplier coordination and product research: follow up on specifications, samples, availability, lead times, and shipping; research practical products for rabbit owners with evidence for suitability, demand, cost, and inventory assumptions.

• Documentation: keep ClickUp tasks, time records, and end-of-day updates current. Document repeatable processes and communicate blockers with the relevant facts and a recommended next step.



WHAT WE REQUIRE

• Real, hands-on Amazon Seller Central AND Shopify experience—not coursework alone.

• Experience managing inventory, orders, fulfillment issues, and customer communication. Explain your MCF experience specifically; do not simply list tools.

• Strong written English, attention to detail, and reliable attendance at agreed meetings.

• Independent research and troubleshooting: review company resources and platform documentation before escalating searchable questions, while asking promptly when a business decision or approval is needed.

• Comfort using ClickUp, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and AI as an assistant while checking its output. Projections must use stated inputs and formulas, not invented sales percentages.

• Reliable internet and a practical backup plan.



HELPFUL BONUSES

ManyChat troubleshooting, rabbit-care or pet-product knowledge, supplier sourcing, TikTok Shop, and demonstrated store-improvement experience. Be honest about what you have used in production and what you are still learning.



HOW WE WORK

We value clear communication, initiative, documentation, and respectful suggestions. Spending, refunds, price or discount changes, and protected live-system changes require approval. You should be able to make progress independently within those boundaries. We provide company-controlled access; never share client credentials or private customer data in your application.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with BURROW READY, then briefly include:

1. Your Amazon and Shopify experience, years of hands-on use, and what you personally owned.

2. One inventory, fulfillment, or account-health problem you personally resolved and how you verified the outcome.

3. Your product-research/supplier experience and any relevant rabbit or pet-product knowledge.

4. Your availability, current commitments, and whether the stated rate and schedule work for you.

5. Your resume and one or two existing, redacted work examples if available.



No new video or lengthy unpaid project is required. Qualified applicants will receive one short, hypothetical written assessment before an interview. Please be specific and honest rather than sending a generic introduction.

title: Virtual Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist (30-Day Paid Trial)
description:
Job Opening: Virtual Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist (30-Day Paid Trial)



Employers: Edgett Law Firm (criminal and juvenile defense) and Edgett Hawk A
 & Injury Law (personal injury)

Location:  McKinney, Texas (virtual)

Type: 30-day paid trial, with the mutual option of a long-term role or standard monthly retainer

Reports to: Scott Edgett, CEO and Mallory Edgett CFO

 

About Us

Edgett Law Firm defends adults and juveniles facing criminal charges in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Edgett Hawk A
 & Injury Law, a partnership between Scott Edgett and Michael Hawk, represents people injured in a
. The two practices have separate brands, audiences and messaging. You will keep them distinct, with separate accounts, ad copy, social pages and tone. We are replacing our current marketing support. We want someone who can build and run a lead engine quickly and who understands that law firm advertising is regulated.



The Role

In the first 30 days you will set up, launch and run paid and local lead-generation channels for both firms. Your goal is qualified calls and form leads as soon as possible. You will also publish daily social media content. Base salary plus bonus payments if over a certain number of qualified leads contact us within the month (details below). 



Immediate Responsibilities

1. Local Services Ads (LSA)

• Set up, verify, maintain, and manage daily the Google Local Services Ads profiles for each firm: business verification, license and insurance documents, service areas and practice categories.

• Manage budgets, bids, hours, lead disputes and review requests.

• Report weekly on leads, cost per lead, booked and disputed leads.



2. Google Ads (PPC)

• Modify or Rebuild and launch PPC Search campaigns separately for criminal defense, juvenile defense and personal injury.

• Do keyword research, create ad groups and write compliant ad copy and extensions.

• Build negative keyword lists, location targeting and call tracking.

• Set up conversion tracking for calls, forms and chats, with correct attribution.

• Optimize daily in week one, then at least twice a week.



3. Google Business Profile (GBP)

• Claim, verify and optimize each firm's profile: categories, services, hours, photos, attributes, Q&A and description.

• Post updates at least weekly and respond to reviews professionally, never revealing client information.

• Set up an ethical review-request process.

• Monitor for suspended listings, duplicates and spam edits.



4. Meta 
 and Instagram)

• Set up Business Manager, Pages, Instagram accounts, Pixel/Conversions API and Lead Ads for each firm.

• Launch and manage lead-generation and awareness campaigns with approved creative.

• Follow Meta's special-category and legal advertising policies.

• Build retargeting audiences from website visitors and engagement, using only lawful, non-confidential data.



5. Daily Social Media Posts and/or Videos

• Publish one post and/or video every day for each law firm (30 posts in the trial for criminal/juvenile and 30 posts for personal injury for a total of 60) across each firm's 5 social media channels, according to the content calendar.

• Mix educational content, community content, FAQs, short video scripts, reviews (with permission) and calls to action.

• Respond to comments and messages within one business day. Route any message that contains case facts to an attorney.

• A sample 30-day calendar is below. You are expected to improve it.



6. Reporting

• Daily: spend, leads and any issues, in a short message.

• Weekly: a one-page dashboard covering cost per lead, call volume, lead quality, top keywords and next steps.

• Day 30: a full review with a recommendation and a proposed budget.



30-Day Trial Plan

Days Milestone

1–2          Access audit. Account setup for Google Ads, LSA, GBP and Meta. LSA & PPC live. Tracking, call tracking and compliance checklist.

3–6         Launch GBP optimization and first Google Ads campaigns. Submit LSA verification. Start daily posts.

7–14 Launch Meta campaigns. Additional landing pages (2 per practice area x 2 = 4) once approved by leadership. First optimization round. First weekly report.

15–30 Scale what works and cut what does not. A/B test creative. Review requests live. Final report and recommendation on Day 30.



Requirements

Must have-

• At least a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads for lead generation, ideally for law firms or other local service businesses would be a plus.

• Direct experience with Google Local Services Ads and Google Business Profile.

• Working knowledge of conversion tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, call tracking).

• Strong writing skills and the ability to create or source graphics and short video.

• Ability to start immediately and show a portfolio or references with results.

• Willingness to follow attorney review of all ads and posts before publication, if necessary in the beginning.

Nice to have-

• Attorney/Lawyer/Law Firm paid marketing background is definitely a plus. 

• Familiarity with CRM and intake tools, such as MyCase, Attorney Fuel, FileVine or similar.

• Experience with both criminal defense and personal injury marketing.



Compliance and Confidentiality

• All ads, posts, landing pages and review responses must never state the word of inference of specializing or specialized. A member of the leadership team approves everything before it goes live, if necessary.

• No guarantees of results, no misleading claims, and no use of client information, case facts or testimonials without written consent.

• The firms own all accounts, pages, ad accounts, domains, creative and data. The Specialist is added as an admin and must never set up accounts in their own name or on their own business assets.

• A confidentiality agreement is required.



Compensation

• 30-day paid trial: paid directly by the firms to the employee on a biweekly basis on Fridays.

• After the trial: a more than fair monthly retainer or salary with the option of performance bonuses tied to qualified leads per month.

• Bonus Opportunities:
Qualified Leads Per Month = $500 Bonus;
Qualified Leads Per Month = $750 Bonus; and 300+ Qualified Leads Per Month = $1000 Bonus.

• There is no commission on ad spend, and no long-term contract is required.



Success Measures for the Trial

• All four channels (LSA, Google Ads, GBP and Meta) updated and/or rebranded and live within the first 7 days, subject to platform approvals.

• First qualified leads within the first 3-5 days.

• Daily posts published on schedule, 30 out of 30.

• Clean tracking, so every lead is attributed to a source.



How to Apply

 your resume, portfolio and salary requirements, along with a short description of the results you produced for a law firm or local service business and how you would implement your previous success in this new law firm opportunity, to 
 line: Digital Marketing Trial – [Your Name]

Include your earliest start date and your trial fee proposal. Requesting immediate availability to start working with the law firms. 

Edgett Law Firm and Edgett Hawk A
 & Injury Law are equal opportunity employers.

title: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA
description:
Pay: $2/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (24hours/week) any day of your choosing 

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites



Copycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $2/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use SellerAmp SAS?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.



If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products that I can actually buy and sell.

title: Production Admin Coordinator (Apparel, Remote, Purchase Orders and Production Admin)
description:
This is a great long-term opportunity to join a globally renowned Australian denim and apparel group, with multiple well-known brands sold around the world. We're hiring a Production Admin Coordinator for a brand-new role in their production team, with real opportunity to grow as the team and the business expand.



About the role

You'll provide dedicated administrative and transactional support to the production function, taking the high-volume system, documentation and tracking work off the production managers so they can focus on planning, supplier management and analysis.



The role is defined by accuracy, consistency and turnaround. Your work feeds directly into supplier orders, delivery schedules, finance and the sales team, so data integrity is the single most important part of the job.



You'll own the admin side of the purchase order lifecycle: from raising the PO and sending it to the factory or supplier, through amendments and ex-factory changes, to delivery into the distribution centre. A big part of the day is supplier communication, with 30 to 40 supplier
s most mornings (barcode requests, order questions, site queries and more).



You'll report to the Senior Production Manager and work closely with one other team member day to day, as well as the Production Manager, Product & Denim Manager, Logistics Manager and the supplier base.



What you'll do



Purchase order administration

- Raise bulk, SMS and recut purchase orders in CIN7, accurately matching approved planning and sales close files.

- Upload FOB and international costs, making sure all negotiated discounts and surcharges are correctly applied.

- Add freight and duty costs to all Australian purchase orders.

- Action approved amendments (cancellations, additions, colour and quantity changes) and keep system data aligned.

- Maintain purchase order data through to delivery, including updates when ex-factory dates change or are delayed.



Delivery schedules and data integrity

- Support delivery schedule creation and maintain it as bookings, handovers and revised dates come through.

- Build and maintain the delivery tracker up to the point stock arrives in the DC.

- Run routine data validation checks across CIN7, planning files and delivery schedules, and flag discrepancies.

- Maintain brand cancellation lists and distribute them to the agreed stakeholders.

- Complete the weekly Magellan portal upload and keep the portal current.

- Export CIN7 barcode data for supplier plan sheets and validate recommended retail prices against brand documents.

- Work in supplier Excel files every day (each supplier has its own).



Recut and tracker management

- Place approved recut purchase orders and provide fabric usage detail for the fabric stock list.

- Navigate the PLM (WFX) and export seasonal style data into Excel for recuts.

- Own the recut tracker, uploading purchase order data and ETAs so the sales team has live visibility.

- Keep all production trackers current, accurate and ready for review at agreed checkpoints.



SMS and seasonal administration

- Prepare SMS order templates and raise SMS purchase orders.

- Produce SMS packing lists and split final packing lists by supplier.

- Support seasonal handover documentation to customer service and the international regions.



Supplier and compliance document support

- Chase suppliers for routine documentation (scope certificates, fibre certification, audit and corrective action plan responses) and file it correctly.

- Log compliance documentation in the relevant portals and escalate anything overdue or non-compliant.

- Follow up outstanding supplier confirmations and acknowledgements.



Supplier communication

- Work through the daily supplier inbox so it no longer lands on the production managers.

- Liaise directly with factories and suppliers by
, phone and video call.

- Capture supplier updates, including ex-factory changes and delays and quality issues on P1 and P2 samples, and feed them back concisely.

- Share ex-factory delays promptly with everyone affected, including the sales team, so major retail accounts hear early.



Reporting support

- Prepare recurring reports and data extracts for the production team.

- Compile inputs for margin, DIFOT and factory performance reporting.

- Complete ad hoc administrative tasks as directed.



Not part of this role: creating or maintaining product data (design team), logistics administration and freight forwarder liaison (logistics coordinator), and top-line supply planning.



How success is measured

- Data accuracy across purchase order and delivery schedule entry.

- Turnaround time against agreed service levels for PO placement and amendments.

- Recut tracker, delivery schedules and Magellan portal up to date at agreed checkpoints.

- Low rework rate.

- Supplier document chases closed on time.

- Administrative load released from the production managers.



What you'll need

- 2+ years in a production, supply chain, sourcing or order administration role, ideally in apparel.

- Strong working knowledge of ERP or PLM systems, including managing purchase orders in an ERP (CIN7, NetSuite, SAP or similar).

- Advanced spreadsheet (Excel) skills and proven accuracy with high-volume data.

- Excellent written English and clear, professional supplier communication.

- Excellent spoken English and comfort on phone and video calls with suppliers.

- Highly organised, able to work to deadlines across time zones with minimal supervision.

- Comfortable asking for clarification rather than assuming: accuracy over speed.

- Strong note taking and quick to learn a new system.

- Fully present across a 9am to 5pm working day, comfortable on camera and quick to respond.



Nice to have

- CIN7 or WFX experience.

- An understanding of logistics.



About you

You bring high energy, enthusiasm and engagement. You take the initiative to solve problems and answer your own questions from your notes and recorded training videos, while knowing when to escalate. You keep people updated early, especially when dates slip.



Training

You'll be trained by the Senior Production Manager, with recorded training videos to refer back to. CIN7 experience isn't required on day one: strong note taking makes the difference.



Why join

- A great long-term, full-time opportunity, not a short contract

- Work behind the scenes for a globally renowned denim and apparel group with multiple well-known brands

- Real opportunity to grow: build your skills in CIN7, PLM and international production, and take on more as the team expands

- Structured training from the Senior Production Manager, plus recorded videos to refer back to

- A supportive, organised production team that values accuracy and early communication

- Fully remote, Monday to Friday



Hours

Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm Melbourne time. That's 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time while Australian daylight saving is on (October to April), and 7:00am to 3:00pm Philippine time from April to October.



How to apply

Please put "PO Admin" in your subject line so we know you've read the whole ad. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

Send your CV and a short note on the purchase order or ERP systems you've used and the volume of POs you've managed.

title: Experienced Loan Processor / Broker Support – Australian Mortgage Broking

Making sure nothing falls through the cracks

rather than:

-First-home buyers

Role details

How to apply

Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Get certified in 30–60 days through consistent quality work and leadership approval.



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- You may split your shift

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Attend team/training meetings around 9 PM – 11 PM PH time (when scheduled)

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- We'll agree on your final schedule during the hiring process - it must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize their brand online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Fluent, professional English

- Clear spoken communication

- Emotional intelligence

- Be calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



You’ll THRIVE here if you:



- Enjoy speaking on camera with clients

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without being micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
Hiring: Backend Manager – E-Commerce / Dropshipping



We are looking for a highly experienced Backend Manager with strong, hands-on experience in e-commerce or/ dropshipping.

We are a Google Dropshipping business generating over $10 million in annual revenue, with 10+ stores and continuing to grow. We are looking for a highly dedicated and reliable VA who is interested in a long-term position and can take full ownership of our backend operations while continuously improving and optimizing our systems. Add brown in your subject line if you read this. 



This person will be responsible for overseeing the entire backend operation, ensuring that orders flow smoothly, costs and margins are properly controlled, suppliers are effectively managed, and customer-related issues—including refunds, disputes, and chargebacks—are handled accurately and efficiently.



The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of working independently while taking ownership of their responsibilities.

Solid e-commerce and dropshipping experience is a MUST. This is not an entry-level position and is not suitable for someone who requires training from scratch. We are looking for someone who already understands the ecommerce backend and can step in, take responsibility, and help us maintain, optimize, and scale our existing systems.



🔥 What We’re Looking For

Proven, hands-on experience managing e-commerce/ dropshipping operations

Strong understanding of overseas dropshipping, including suppliers, fulfillment, shipping, tracking, and delivery processes

Available to work full-time and willing to work longer hours when necessary

Able to take full ownership of the backend operation

Strong experience handling refunds, disputes, and chargebacks

Experience managing or working with phone/customer support agents

Strong understanding of COGS, margins, refunds, fulfillment costs, and overall profitability

Highly organized, proactive, analytical, and detail-oriented

Strong communication and supplier-management skills

Willing to continuously skill up and learn the entire business, including frontend operations

Able to identify problems before they become major issues and take action without waiting for instructions



📌 Key Responsibilities



1. Order Flow & Backend Operations

Monitor the entire order flow from purchase to fulfillment and delivery

Ensure orders are processed accurately and on time

Check for failed, delayed, held, cancelled, or problematic orders

Monitor tracking numbers and shipping status

Identify bottlenecks in the fulfillment process and resolve them quickly

Conduct regular overall backend checks to ensure operations are running smoothly

Ensure all backend processes are being followed according to SOPs



2. Refund & Cancellation Monitoring

Monitor the overall refund percentage and identify unusual increases or trends

Track refunds by product, offer, source, customer issue, and other relevant factors

Review refund reasons and identify recurring problems

Monitor cancellation rates and determine why customers are cancelling

Ensure refunds are processed according to company policies and SOPs

Work with the team to reduce unnecessary refunds while maintaining proper customer service



3. Disputes & Chargebacks

Handle and oversee payment disputes and chargebacks

Prepare and submit appropriate evidence/documentation for disputes

Monitor dispute and chargeback rates

Track dispute outcomes and identify recurring causes

Develop and improve processes to prevent future disputes and chargebacks

Solid prior experience handling e-commerce disputes/chargebacks is required



4. Supplier Management

Communicate directly with overseas suppliers and fulfillment partners

Monitor supplier performance, responsiveness, pricing, and fulfillment times

Follow up on delayed, missing, incorrect, or damaged orders

Resolve supplier-related issues quickly

Negotiate and communicate regarding product costs, shipping costs, and other operational concerns

Ensure suppliers are following our required fulfillment standards

Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers



5. COGS & Margin Monitoring

Monitor COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) across products and orders

Ensure product and fulfillment costs remain aligned with the required margins

Identify increases in product, shipping, or fulfillment costs

Flag products where COGS is negatively affecting profitability

Regularly check whether actual costs match expected costs

Communicate with suppliers when costs need to be reviewed or renegotiated

Work closely with management to protect overall product margins



6. Phone Support Operations

We have a dedicated phone support team, and the Backend Manager will need to understand and oversee how phone support connects with backend operations.

Monitor phone support processes and performance

Ensure phone agents follow proper procedures for orders, cancellations, refunds, and customer concerns

Review escalated customer cases

Identify recurring issues coming from phone support

Ensure information provided by phone agents is accurate and consistent with backend policies

Coordinate with phone agents when an issue requires backend intervention



7. Team Management & Accountability

Manage and oversee backend team members

Assign responsibilities and monitor completion

Review team performance and productivity

Ensure SOPs are consistently followed

Train and coach team members when needed

Handle escalations and critical operational issues

Ensure the backend team maintains a high level of accuracy and accountability



8. Frontend & Overall Business Knowledge

Although the primary responsibility is backend operations, we want someone who is willing to learn the entire business.



You should have, or be willing to develop, working knowledge of:

Product pages and store management

Offers and upsells

Checkout/customer journey

Promotions and discount codes

Basic conversion and sales concepts

Frontend customer experience

How frontend decisions affect refunds, fulfillment, COGS, and overall profitability

Subscriptions

The long-term goal is for the Backend Manager to understand how the entire business operates, not just their individual department.



9. Reporting & Process Improvement

Monitor important operational KPIs

Track orders, refunds, cancellations, disputes, chargebacks, COGS, and fulfillment performance

Prepare regular reports and identify trends

Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend solutions

Create, update, and improve SOPs

Find opportunities to automate repetitive tasks

Continuously improve the backend operation as the business grows



10. Time Management, Team Coordination & Operational Tracking

Manage your own time effectively and prioritize tasks based on operational importance and urgency

Schedule and coordinate regular calls and meetings with team members, suppliers, and other relevant parties

Follow up with team members to ensure tasks and responsibilities are completed on time

Monitor team performance, productivity, and accountability on an ongoing basis

Keep track of important issues, decisions, follow-ups, and outstanding tasks

Document what is working well, what is not working, and what needs to be improved

Maintain a clear record of recurring problems, mistakes, delays, and operational issues so they can be addressed systematically

Proactively identify areas where the team or backend operation can be improved

Make sure important issues do not get forgotten or remain unresolved

Maintain a clear overview of the daily and weekly operational status and communicate important updates to management



 The Person We Want

We are looking for someone who can eventually own the entire backend with minimal supervision.

You should be able to look at the operation and immediately understand:

What is working? What is not working? Where are we losing money? What needs to be fixed? Who needs to handle it? And what needs to happen next?

You must be comfortable taking ownership, communicating with suppliers and team members, analyzing numbers, solving problems, and stepping into the details when necessary.

We are looking for an operator, not someone who simply delegates tasks.



Requirements

✅ Solid e-commerce/dropshipping experience

✅ Experience with overseas suppliers/fulfillment

✅ Experience handling refunds and cancellations

✅ Strong dispute/chargeback experience

✅ Understanding of COGS and profit margins

✅ Experience managing or working with phone support teams

✅ Strong operational and analytical skills

✅ Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

✅ Full-time availability

✅ Willingness to work longer hours when operationally necessary

✅ Willingness to learn both backend and frontend operations

✅ Strong sense of ownership and accountability



Optional:

✅ Experience with AI and outsourcing

✅ CLaude code Chatgpt Codex

title: Payroll/Bookkeeper - Experienced (Australian Client)
description:
About Us

Deryan Financial Group is a family-owned accounting and finance firm with over 40 years of experience helping clients make smarter financial and lending decisions.

We combine the expertise of mortgage broking and accounting to deliver end-to-end solutions — from securing the right loan to optimising tax and business outcomes.



The Opportunity

If you're an experienced bookkeeping or payroll professional who takes pride in accuracy, organisation, and compliance — this is your opportunity to take ownership of payroll processing and BAS preparation within our growing accounting division.

You'll manage the end-to-end payroll function for a portfolio of small business clients, prepare and lodge quarterly and monthly Business Activity Statements, and ensure client records are reconciled and compliant with current ATO, Fair Work and superannuation requirements. You'll work closely with our senior accountants and tax agents, keeping payroll and BAS cycles running to deadline so the team can focus on advisory and more complex work.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives on structure and recurring deadlines, and is confident managing a high-volume client base through weekly, fortnightly, monthly and quarterly cycles.



What You'll Do

• Process payroll for a portfolio of small business clients across weekly, fortnightly and monthly cycles, including new employee setup, terminations, leave and award interpretation.

• Lodge Single Touch Payroll (STP) events and complete end-of-year STP finalisation.

• Calculate and reconcile superannuation guarantee obligations and process quarterly super payments.

• Prepare and lodge monthly and quarterly BAS and IAS, including GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalments.

• Reconcile GST, payroll and superannuation accounts to the general ledger before each lodgement.

• Review client-supplied records and bookkeeping for completeness, following up directly with clients on missing or unclear information.

• Prepare BAS workpapers for senior accountant or tax agent review and sign-off, addressing review queries promptly.

• Manage related ATO correspondence, payment plans and follow-ups.

• Maintain accurate, well-organised client files and a lodgement calendar covering all payroll, super and BAS due dates.

• Communicate directly with clients regarding payroll queries, lodgement status and amounts payable.

• Identify and implement process improvements to streamline payroll and BAS administration.



About You

• 3+ years' experience processing payroll and preparing BAS in an Australian public practice, bookkeeping or tax agent environment (essential).

• Sound working knowledge of GST, PAYG withholding, PAYG instalments, superannuation guarantee and STP requirements.

• Working knowledge of modern awards, leave entitlements and Fair Work obligations.

• Experience with Xero Payroll and Xero (essential); MYOB, QuickBooks or KeyPay/Employment Hero an advantage.

• BAS Agent registration, or eligibility to register, highly regarded.

• Confident managing a high-volume client base with strong attention to recurring deadlines.

• Excellent attention to detail and time management skills.

• Professional communication skills and ability to manage client relationships independently.

• Organised, reliable, and proactive in identifying issues before they arise.



What's on Offer

• Competitive salary based on experience.

• Supportive, professional, and family-oriented team culture.

• Opportunity to build deep expertise in payroll and BAS compliance within a multi-disciplinary firm.

• Exposure to a wide range of clients and industries.





Please send your resume to 
 with a subject line Payroll/Bookkeeper.

You spot the thing nobody assigned and raise it. You don't sit blocked in silence.



You communicate constantly and clearly.

We're fully remote. That means written updates, honest status, and early warning when something will slip. Going quiet for a day doesn't work here.



You use AI well, and you own the output.

This is a requirement, not a bonus. We expect you to use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or whatever works) to move faster on:

• Scaffolding

• Refactors

• Tests

• Debugging

• Unfamiliar APIs



The non-negotiable: 

You must be able to explain and defend every line you ship, whether you or an AI wrote it.

AI that speeds you up is what we want. AI you can't reason about is what we screen out.

We apply the same standard to libraries and packages: use them where they earn their place, and understand them either way.



The Work

You won't be starting a todo app from scratch. You'll work inside an existing modular Laravel product with:

• Company-level tenancy

• Permissions

• Queues

• Real customer workflows



A query that forgets to scope by company is not a small bug. It's a data leak.

You'll also work on Next.js sites backed by Laravel APIs, including our public storefront and a growing number of client websites we're migrating onto that stack.



We can teach the stack and our conventions. We can't teach curiosity, communication, or care about tenant boundaries.



Technical Requirements



Core

• PHP and Laravel: controllers, middleware, services, form requests, Eloquent, queues

• React and TypeScript: components, hooks, typed props, reusable UI

• Inertia.js, or a clear willingness to learn it fast. This is how our frontend talks to Laravel; it is not a typical REST SPA

• Next.js: App Router, server and client components, data fetching, and consuming Laravel APIs

• HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (ES6+)

• Git, and comfort working in an existing codebase rather than starting from zero

• Testing as part of the job: Pest (or PHPUnit) on the backend. You'll be expected to add and maintain tests

• Comfort reading other people's code and changing it without breaking tenancy, permissions, or existing behaviour



You'll Get Productive Faster If You Already Know

• Multi-tenant / company-scoped data

• Laravel modules or another modular monolith architecture

• Policies, roles, and permission-aware UI

• Playwright or other E2E testing

• Horizon, Redis, or real-time systems such as Reverb / WebSockets

• Tailwind and component libraries such as Shadcn



Useful, But Not Required

• WordPress: some client sites and integrations still live there

• Experience working across more than one service, including APIs, webhooks, and JWT



Experience

We're open to both fresh graduates and experienced developers.



If You're Experienced

We're looking for roughly:

• 3+ years building production Laravel applications

• 2+ years working with React

• Solid TypeScript experience

• Production experience with Next.js

Inertia experience is a plus, but strong Laravel + React developers generally pick it up quickly.

If you're short on years but can prove the depth, apply anyway. The assessment d
, not the CV.



If You're a Fresh Graduate

No commercial experience is required. Bring solid fundamentals and a project (coursework, personal, freelance, or internship) that you can walk us through and explain.



We can teach Laravel, Inertia, and how this product is put together. We can't teach curiosity or communication.



Hiring Process

1. Application

Include all of the following:

• Your CV

• Links to anything you've built

• One paragraph about a problem you solved that you're proud of and how you approached it

• A link to your Loom code walkthrough video (see below)



The Code Walkthrough Video

Your video MUST be recorded and shared on Loom (
). We won't accept YouTube, Google Drive, Vimeo, file attachments, or any other platform. Loom's free plan is all you need.

Record a Loom video of 5 minutes or less, with your screen and your voice, walking us through the code of one of your recent projects. Camera is optional.



Before you send the link, make sure:

• Sharing is set so anyone with the link can view, with no sign-in or access request

• The transcript is turned on, which is Loom's default setting



In the video, show us:

• What the project does and how the code is structured

• One part of the code you're proud of, and why you built it that way

• One thing you'd change or improve if you did it again

• If and how you used AI to build it: which tools you used, show us an example of what you asked it, what it gave you, and what you kept, changed, or threw away

If you didn't use AI on that project, tell us that and explain how you'd use it now.

Use code you're allowed to share. Don't show passwords, API keys, or client data.

Speak clearly and explain the code in your own words. Reading from a script or letting AI narrate defeats the purpose.

Important: We won't review applications without the correct subject line, or without a working Loom link with the transcript turned on. Videos on any other platform will not be reviewed.



2. Skills Assessment

You'll complete a short, focused task designed around the shape of the real job:

• Existing Laravel + React/Inertia code

• A fuzzy requirement

• Tenant-safe changes

• A test

We're not looking for perfection. We want to see your approach, your code, and how you think.

Tell us which AI tools you used and where. Using them is expected; hiding it isn't.



3. Microsoft Teams Interview

You'll meet with our CEO and development team. We'll cover:

• 3–4 short code snippets that we'll ask you to explain. Clear reasoning matters more than being right on the first try

• Real-world development scenarios: an unclear spec, a bug that might involve tenancy, a queue that didn't run

• Communication and collaboration questions



What You Get

• Real full-stack work: Laravel, Inertia, React/TypeScript, and Next.js

• A team of experienced developers to learn from

• Room to grow into ownership of a module

• Fully remote

• Monday to Friday, 8-hour shift

• Competitive salary

• Health insurance

• 13th-month salary

• Overtime pay

• A team that expects you to use the best tools available, including AI



Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Remote



Interested?

If you're confident in your reasoning, comfortable across backend and frontend, careful with other people's data, and communicate like someone who wants the whole team to succeed, we'd like to hear from you.



Only apply via OnlineJobs. Use your favourite coding language + your favourite AI model as the subject line, and include a Loom video link. Applications sent any other way, or with video on any other platform, will not be considered.
