title: Job Description — Appointment Setter (LinkedIn, Warm Inbound)
description:
The opportunity



You'll book calls with venture-backed founders and VC fund leads — YC companies, a16z-backed startups, and funds with established budgets.



You'll train directly under two operators:



The founder of CETUP. Builds client acquisition systems for consultants and agencies. You'll learn content strategy, DM frameworks, and sales management.



**A San Francisco multimedia agency founder** — crew credits on major network productions, clients backed by top-tier VCs. You'll learn how premium creative work is sold.



Content, sales, and sales management. Strong preparation if you intend to run your own business eventually.



## Pay



- Hourly base, paid reliably

- Commission, negotiated around what you bring in



This business has done $100K+ MRR at peak. At 5%, that's roughly $5,000/month on business you source.



## The company



California media studio making launch films, brand films, and investor media for venture-backed startups and VC funds. Founded 2023.



- 30+ launch and demo films, 80+ clients

- 25 launch films for companies in a single YC batch

- Clients backed by a16z, Accel, NFX, First Round, Techstars, Y Combinator

- Crew credits on major streaming and network productions

- Shot in person. No AI-generated video.



## The role



This is **warm inbound setting**. The founder posts organic content on LinkedIn that attracts ICP attention. Your job is to convert that engagement into booked calls, and to build pipeline from the audience that content brings in.



You are not cold prospecting into a list. You're working people who have already signalled interest — likes, comments, profile views, follows, replies — and moving them through a structured conversation into a call.



**Engagement activation.** Every post generates a signal set: likers, commenters, new followers, profile visitors. You work that list daily. Someone who engaged with a post on launch strategy is a warmer lead than anyone on a scraped list, and the window to reach them is short. Speed matters here.



**Comments as pipeline.** You'll comment on ICP posts to build familiarity before any direct message lands. A comment that adds a real thought or asks a question worth answering does two jobs: it earns a reply, and it makes your name recognisable when you do reach out.



**Connection requests.** Sent with a short, specific note referencing what they're building or something they posted. The objective is acceptance and a reply, not volume.



**Openers.** The first message gets the reply. You'll learn the framework, but the standard is that it reads like someone who actually looked at their profile and had a thought about it.



**Working the conversation.** Once someone replies, you run the framework: build rapport, earn the right to ask questions, discover what they're dealing with, qualify against ICP criteria, then pitch the call. You'll be trained on the exact sequence. Judgement still matters — these are experienced people who recognise a script.



**Daily workflow.** Clear the inbox, action new engagement from recent posts, run trigger-based follow-ups, keep the pipeline moving, log activity so conversion rates by stage are visible.



**Your ICP:** technical founders in top accelerators facing a public launch without a story ready, and platform or marketing leads at seed and Series A funds.



## Before you apply



These are busy, discerning people who ignore most of what reaches their inbox. Your messages need to be genuinely good. This isn't copy-paste work, and it isn't a role for learning the fundamentals.



**Requirements:**



- Previous appointment setting experience — required

- Highly coachable, quick to apply feedback

- Motivated to develop a real skill



## How to apply



Complete the Tally form below.



**One rule:** send a custom Loom recorded for this role, 1 to 1.5 minutes. Generalised Looms will be disqualified.

title: Experienced Social Media Manager – Luxury Travel Company
description:
# Experienced Social Media Manager – Luxury Travel Company



**Company:** KNB Travel LLC  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday | U.S. Eastern Time (ET) Hours  

**Platforms:**
, Instagram, Threads & TikTok  

**Industry:** Luxury Group Travel



## About KNB Travel



KNB Travel is a U.S.-based boutique luxury travel company specializing in **intimate, curated group travel experiences**.



Founded by Dr. Ernesta Battle, KNB Travel creates thoughtfully curated international travel experiences primarily for African American professionals, entrepreneurs, and retirees who are ready to enjoy their **Soft Life** without the stress of planning every detail themselves.



Our trips combine upscale accommodations, cultural experiences, dining, entertainment, exciting activities, and community. We don't simply sell destinations—we market the **experience of traveling with KNB Travel.**



We are looking for an experienced Social Media Manager in the Philippines who can help us grow that community.



## About the Position



We are looking for an **experienced Social Media Manager—not simply someone who can create graphics and schedule posts.**



Your responsibility will be to strategically manage and grow KNB Travel's presence on:



*
 | Instagram | Threads | TikTok**



This is a **Monday–Friday position working U.S. Eastern Time (ET) hours. Applicants must be available to consistently work during these hours.**



You must understand social media strategy, content creation, community engagement, *
 Events, analytics, and audience growth.**



We have a large library of professional travel photos and videos from our trips. You should know how to turn those assets into engaging social content that makes people want to follow KNB Travel, interact with our community, and learn more about our trips.



## Your Responsibilities



### Social Media Management & Growth



- Develop and manage a monthly social media content calendar.

- Create and publish content across
, Instagram, Threads, and TikTok.

- Create platform-specific content rather than posting the exact same content everywhere.

- Create Reels, short-form videos, Stories, carousels, and engaging posts.

- Write compelling social media captions in KNB Travel's brand voice.

- Grow followers, reach, engagement, and community participation.

- Research relevant travel trends, sounds, content ideas, and social media opportunities.

- Monitor competitors and identify opportunities for KNB Travel.

- Recommend new ideas and strategies instead of waiting for instructions for every post.



###
 Events



**Experience with
 Events is very important for this position.**



You should know how to:



- Create and optimize
 Events.

- Develop content strategies for existing Events.

- Keep Events active and engaging.

- Increase awareness and engagement within Events.

- Engage with people who mark themselves Interested or Going.

- Review Event performance and recommend improvements.



We do not want someone who simply creates a
 Event and leaves it untouched.



### Community Management



You will help us build an active KNB Travel community by:



- Monitoring comments and engagement.

- Responding appropriately to comments and messages.

- Starting and encouraging conversations.

- Engaging with followers and prospective travelers.

- Identifying potential customer questions or leads.

- Encouraging engagement with past and current travelers.

- Helping KNB Travel maintain a consistent and active presence online.



### Analytics & Reporting



**You must know how to analyze social media performance.**



We expect you to monitor metrics such as:



- Follower growth

- Reach and impressions

- Engagement

- Shares and saves

- Reels and video performance

- Profile visits

- Link clicks

-
 Event performance

- Website traffic from social media

- Top-performing and low-performing content



We don't just want a report showing numbers.



We want someone who can tell us:



**What worked? Why did it work? What didn't work? What should we change? What should we do more of?**



You should be able to use analytics to help guide the next month's strategy.



## Required Qualifications



**Please apply only if you meet these requirements:**



- Minimum **2 years of professional Social Media Manager experience**

- Previous experience working with a **travel, tourism, hospitality, destination, or closely related company**

- Professional experience managing
 and Instagram

- Experience managing TikTok

- Strong knowledge of
 Events

- Experience with Meta Business Suite

- Experience analyzing social media metrics

- Experience growing social media audiences and engagement

- Strong short-form video/Reels skills

- Strong written English

- Strong copywriting and storytelling ability

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

- Ability to manage multiple social media campaigns and trip promotions at the same time

- **Must be available to work Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) hours**



Experience with **Canva, CapCut, Threads, social media scheduling tools, and analytics/reporting platforms** is strongly preferred.



## Who Will Do Well in This Role?



We want someone who is **creative AND analytical.**



You should enjoy creating beautiful travel content, but you should also want to know whether that content actually performed.



You should be proactive. If engagement drops, we expect you to investigate why and recommend a solution.



If a Reel performs exceptionally well, we expect you to recognize it and determine how we can build upon that success.



Most importantly, you must understand that our goal isn't simply to post every day.



**Our goal is to grow an engaged community that becomes interested in traveling with KNB Travel.**



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. Links to social media accounts or a portfolio showing accounts you have professionally managed.



Please also answer these **two questions** in your application:



**1. How many years have you worked professionally as a Social Media Manager, and what experience do you have working with travel, tourism, or hospitality companies?**



**2. Briefly describe your experience with
 Events and using social media analytics to grow engagement or an online community.**





**Please do not apply if your experience is primarily managing your own personal social media accounts.**



We are looking for an experienced Social Media Manager who wants to become a long-term part of the KNB Travel team and help us intentionally grow our brand and community.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:
Senior Salesforce Administrator | Work From Home | Full Time



We’re OpenCorp. For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped everyday Australians build wealth through property with the right strategy, advice and ongoing support.



We’re looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to join our Technology Team. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can do more than administer Salesforce — you’ll work with stakeholders to understand business problems, design smart solutions and take them all the way from discovery through to delivery.



You’ll play a key role in how Salesforce supports our business, balancing day-to-day platform administration with solution design, project delivery, continuous improvement and mentoring other Salesforce Administrators.



What you’ll be doing:



- Owning day-to-day Salesforce administration, including users, permissions, security, reports, dashboards, data quality and platform health

- Managing and resolving Salesforce support requests while looking beyond the immediate issue to identify opportunities for improvement

- Working directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, processes and desired outcomes

- Leading discovery sessions and translating business requirements into practical Salesforce solutions

- Designing and building scalable solutions using Salesforce Flow, validation rules, formulas, approvals, custom objects and other declarative tools

- Managing Salesforce projects from discovery and solution design through build, testing, UAT, deployment and post-release support

- Reviewing Salesforce solutions developed by other team members to ensure quality, maintainability and consistency

- Helping strengthen our Salesforce DevOps and release-management practices

- Supporting integrations, APIs, data migrations and other connected business platforms

- Creating clear solution, technical, process and user documentation

- Mentoring Salesforce Administrators and sharing knowledge across the Technology Team

- Continuously identifying ways Salesforce can reduce manual work, improve data quality and create a better user experience



We’re looking for someone with

- At least 4 years of demonstrated Salesforce experience, including senior administration or consulting responsibilities

- Salesforce Certified Administrator certification

- Salesforce Platform App Builder certification or equivalent demonstrated capability

- Advanced hands-on experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative automation

- Proven experience taking Salesforce projects from discovery and requirements through build, UAT and deployment

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and confidently leading solution discussions

- Practical experience with Salesforce DevOps, source control, structured deployments or release-management tools

- Experience conducting peer reviews and applying Salesforce development standards

- Experience supporting integrations, data migrations or connected business systems

- Strong problem-solving skills with the confidence to challenge a request and understand the real business problem before building a solution

- Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

- A strong focus on quality, documentation, scalability and long-term maintainability



Highly regarded

- Salesforce Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Sales Cloud Consultant certification

- Experience with Gearset, Copado, Flosum, Salesforce DevOps Center or similar tools

- Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, outbound messages or native Salesforce integrations

- Experience with Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot), Sales Engagement, Experience Cloud, Agentforce or Data Cloud

- Experience mentoring Salesforce Administrators or helping improve technical standards across a team

- Experience working remotely with Australian, UK or US stakeholders

- Exposure to Agile delivery, Jira and Confluence



About you

- You’re an experienced Salesforce professional who likes understanding why something needs to change before d
 how to build it.

- You’re comfortable getting hands-on in Salesforce, but you can also step back and think about the bigger picture — the business process, user experience, data, integrations and long-term impact of a solution.

- You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions constructively and take ownership of your work from initial discovery through to delivery. You care about building solutions that are scalable, maintainable and genuinely useful, and you enjoy helping other team members strengthen their Salesforce capability along the way.



Salary and Benefits

- Opportunity to balance your career and lifestyle and WORK FROM HOME!

- Government-mandated benefits

- Paid Philippine public holidays

- Competitive monthly salary based on experience (inclusive of PHP 7,500 non-taxable allowance)

description:
We're looking for an Accounts Receivable Specialist to join an early-stage security technology startup as part of their offshore operations team.



This company uses technology to make it easier for businesses to access and manage security services. This role will focus on making sure client accounts are accurate, invoices are paid on time, and payment issues are followed up on and resolved quickly.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with customers, solving problems, and keeping things moving. You'll communicate directly with clients and agencies, follow up on outstanding invoices, verify payments, and help make sure accounts are accurate and up to date.



As part of an early-stage company, you'll have a lot of ownership in the role. You'll be trained on their systems and processes, but you'll also be expected to take initiative, work independently, make decisions, and take things and run with them.



What You'll Do

What We're Looking For

- Experience working with a staffing agency, recruitment agency, BPO, or other service-based agency is highly preferred.

title: Backend Manager
description:
Hiring: Backend Manager – E-Commerce / Dropshipping



We are looking for a highly experienced Backend Manager with strong, hands-on experience in e-commerce or/ dropshipping.

We are a Google Dropshipping business generating over $10 million in annual revenue, with 10+ stores and continuing to grow. We are looking for a highly dedicated and reliable VA who is interested in a long-term position and can take full ownership of our backend operations while continuously improving and optimizing our systems. Add brown in your subject line if you read this.



This person will be responsible for overseeing the entire backend operation, ensuring that orders flow smoothly, costs and margins are properly controlled, suppliers are effectively managed, and customer-related issues—including refunds, disputes, and chargebacks—are handled accurately and efficiently.



The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of working independently while taking ownership of their responsibilities.

Solid e-commerce and dropshipping experience is a MUST. This is not an entry-level position and is not suitable for someone who requires training from scratch. We are looking for someone who already understands the ecommerce backend and can step in, take responsibility, and help us maintain, optimize, and scale our existing systems.



🔥 What We’re Looking For

Proven, hands-on experience managing e-commerce/ dropshipping operations

Strong understanding of overseas dropshipping, including suppliers, fulfillment, shipping, tracking, and delivery processes

Available to work full-time and willing to work longer hours when necessary

Able to take full ownership of the backend operation

Strong experience handling refunds, disputes, and chargebacks

Experience managing or working with phone/customer support agents

Strong understanding of COGS, margins, refunds, fulfillment costs, and overall profitability

Highly organized, proactive, analytical, and detail-oriented

Strong communication and supplier-management skills

Willing to continuously skill up and learn the entire business, including frontend operations

Able to identify problems before they become major issues and take action without waiting for instructions



📌 Key Responsibilities



1. Order Flow & Backend Operations

Monitor the entire order flow from purchase to fulfillment and delivery

Ensure orders are processed accurately and on time

Check for failed, delayed, held, cancelled, or problematic orders

Monitor tracking numbers and shipping status

Identify bottlenecks in the fulfillment process and resolve them quickly

Conduct regular overall backend checks to ensure operations are running smoothly

Ensure all backend processes are being followed according to SOPs



2. Refund & Cancellation Monitoring

Monitor the overall refund percentage and identify unusual increases or trends

Track refunds by product, offer, source, customer issue, and other relevant factors

Review refund reasons and identify recurring problems

Monitor cancellation rates and determine why customers are cancelling

Ensure refunds are processed according to company policies and SOPs

Work with the team to reduce unnecessary refunds while maintaining proper customer service



3. Disputes & Chargebacks

Handle and oversee payment disputes and chargebacks

Prepare and submit appropriate evidence/documentation for disputes

Monitor dispute and chargeback rates

Track dispute outcomes and identify recurring causes

Develop and improve processes to prevent future disputes and chargebacks

Solid prior experience handling e-commerce disputes/chargebacks is required



4. Supplier Management

Communicate directly with overseas suppliers and fulfillment partners

Monitor supplier performance, responsiveness, pricing, and fulfillment times

Follow up on delayed, missing, incorrect, or damaged orders

Resolve supplier-related issues quickly

Negotiate and communicate regarding product costs, shipping costs, and other operational concerns

Ensure suppliers are following our required fulfillment standards

Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers



5. COGS & Margin Monitoring

Monitor COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) across products and orders

Ensure product and fulfillment costs remain aligned with the required margins

Identify increases in product, shipping, or fulfillment costs

Flag products where COGS is negatively affecting profitability

Regularly check whether actual costs match expected costs

Communicate with suppliers when costs need to be reviewed or renegotiated

Work closely with management to protect overall product margins



6. Phone Support Operations

We have a dedicated phone support team, and the Backend Manager will need to understand and oversee how phone support connects with backend operations.

Monitor phone support processes and performance

Ensure phone agents follow proper procedures for orders, cancellations, refunds, and customer concerns

Review escalated customer cases

Identify recurring issues coming from phone support

Ensure information provided by phone agents is accurate and consistent with backend policies

Coordinate with phone agents when an issue requires backend intervention



7. Team Management & Accountability

Manage and oversee backend team members

Assign responsibilities and monitor completion

Review team performance and productivity

Ensure SOPs are consistently followed

Train and coach team members when needed

Handle escalations and critical operational issues

Ensure the backend team maintains a high level of accuracy and accountability



8. Frontend & Overall Business Knowledge

Although the primary responsibility is backend operations, we want someone who is willing to learn the entire business.



You should have, or be willing to develop, working knowledge of:

Product pages and store management

Offers and upsells

Checkout/customer journey

Promotions and discount codes

Basic conversion and sales concepts

Frontend customer experience

How frontend decisions affect refunds, fulfillment, COGS, and overall profitability

Subscriptions

The long-term goal is for the Backend Manager to understand how the entire business operates, not just their individual department.



9. Reporting & Process Improvement

Monitor important operational KPIs

Track orders, refunds, cancellations, disputes, chargebacks, COGS, and fulfillment performance

Prepare regular reports and identify trends

Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend solutions

Create, update, and improve SOPs

Find opportunities to automate repetitive tasks

Continuously improve the backend operation as the business grows



10. Time Management, Team Coordination & Operational Tracking

Manage your own time effectively and prioritize tasks based on operational importance and urgency

Schedule and coordinate regular calls and meetings with team members, suppliers, and other relevant parties

Follow up with team members to ensure tasks and responsibilities are completed on time

Monitor team performance, productivity, and accountability on an ongoing basis

Keep track of important issues, decisions, follow-ups, and outstanding tasks

Document what is working well, what is not working, and what needs to be improved

Maintain a clear record of recurring problems, mistakes, delays, and operational issues so they can be addressed systematically

Proactively identify areas where the team or backend operation can be improved

Make sure important issues do not get forgotten or remain unresolved

Maintain a clear overview of the daily and weekly operational status and communicate important updates to management



The Person We Want

We are looking for someone who can eventually own the entire backend with minimal supervision.

You should be able to look at the operation and immediately understand:

What is working? What is not working? Where are we losing money? What needs to be fixed? Who needs to handle it? And what needs to happen next?

You must be comfortable taking ownership, communicating with suppliers and team members, analyzing numbers, solving problems, and stepping into the details when necessary.

We are looking for an operator, not someone who simply delegates tasks.



Requirements

✅ Solid e-commerce/dropshipping experience

✅ Experience with overseas suppliers/fulfillment

✅ Experience handling refunds and cancellations

✅ Strong dispute/chargeback experience

✅ Understanding of COGS and profit margins

✅ Experience managing or working with phone support teams

✅ Strong operational and analytical skills

✅ Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

✅ Full-time availability

✅ Willingness to work longer hours when operationally necessary

✅ Willingness to learn both backend and frontend operations

✅ Strong sense of ownership and accountability



Optional:

✅ Experience with AI and outsourcing

✅ CLaude code Chatgpt Codex

title: Website Development
description:
We are an established roofing and solar company in Vancouver, Canada, and I'm looking for someone to build us a new website and hopefully continue working with us after it's launched.



I'm not looking for a basic template website. I want to invest in doing this properly and build something that will be current for the next several years.



The main things I'm looking for are a website that is very fast, built properly for SEO from the start, easy to keep updating, completely trackable for our marketing, and ready for the way AI is changing search.



I'm not a web developer, so I'm also looking for someone who can recommend the best way to build it rather than me telling you what programming language or platform to use.



### SEO From the Beginning



SEO is extremely important to us, and I want it considered while the website is being designed and built, not something we try to add afterwards.



We are a local home-service company, so local SEO is particularly important.



We want to target the actual cities, areas and neighbourhoods where we work and build good-quality pages around them. I don't want hundreds of basically identical pages with just the city or neighbourhood name changed.



I'd like the site structure, URLs, internal linking, schema/structured data, images, page titles, technical SEO, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and other important SEO work done properly from the beginning.



### AI and the Future of Search



I also want the website built with AI search in mind.



More people are using ChatGPT, Google AI, Bing/Copilot and other AI tools to find information and businesses. I want our website structured so these systems can easily crawl it, understand what we do and potentially use or reference the information we publish.



I'm not expecting anyone to guarantee that we'll rank #1 on Google or be recommended by ChatGPT. I'm looking for someone who understands where search is going and can make sure we're not building a website that's already outdated.



I also want the site built in a way that will make it easier to use AI to help manage and update it in the future.



### Website Speed



I want the website to be extremely fast, especially on mobile.



I don't want it loaded down with unnecessary plugins, scripts or features that make it slow.



I'm open to whatever platform or technology you recommend, as long as you can explain why you think it's the right choice for us.



### Our Roofing Projects



One of the biggest parts of the website will be our actual work.



We've been in business for many years and have a good collection of photos from completed roofs. We'll also be continually adding new projects.



I'd like a good system for adding projects without having to manually build every page from scratch.



A project could include information such as:



- Area or neighbourhood

- Type of roofing

- Existing roof

- New roofing system

- Material and manufacturer

- Product and colour

- Project description

- Problems or challenges encountered

- How we solved those problems

- Before, during and after photos

- Customer review when available



I'd like these projects connected throughout the website.



For example, if we complete a standing-seam metal roof in a particular neighbourhood, that project could appear in our metal roofing section, the appropriate neighbourhood section and other relevant areas of the website.



### Roofing Case Studies



I also want to build really good case studies around the different types of roofing work we do.



This would include things such as:



- Standing-seam metal roofing

- Asphalt shingles

- Cedar roofing and cedar replacement

- Composite/synthetic roofing

- Flat roofing

- TPO

- Torch-on roofing

- Skylights

- Solar and roofing/solar projects

- Difficult or unusual roofing projects



These should be more than just photo galleries.



I'd like case studies to explain what was there originally, what problem the homeowner was trying to solve, what options were considered, why we recommended a particular solution, what products and materials were used, challenges we encountered and how the finished project turned out.



Over time, I want the website to become a very useful source of roofing information based on projects we've actually completed and our real experience in the industry.



### Local Content



We want strong pages for the areas and neighbourhoods we actually service.



I don't want low-quality pages created simply to target keywords.



Where possible, I'd like our location pages supported by real projects, photographs, case studies and information that's actually relevant to homes and roofing in that particular area.



### Photos and Video



We have a good collection of photos from completed roofing projects, along with some video, and we'll continue adding more as we complete new projects.



At the moment, we have approximately **200 project photos and around 20 videos** that could potentially be used as starting content for the new website.



I'd like these organized properly so they can be used throughout the website without slowing it down.



Photos should be able to relate to the appropriate project, roofing system, service, product, case study and location where relevant.



Images and video should be properly optimized for website performance while still looking high quality.



As we complete new jobs, we want it to be simple and efficient for the developer to add new photos, videos and projects to the website.



### CallRail and Marketing Tracking



This is very important to us.



We use or intend to use CallRail, and I want the website set up so we can properly track where our leads are coming from.



This should include things such as:



- CallRail Dynamic Number Insertion

- Telephone call tracking

- Contact form tracking

- Quote request tracking

- Mobile click-to-call tracking

- Google organic traffic

- Google Business Profile

- Google Ads when we're running them

- Bing/Microsoft

- Social media

- Referral websites

- Other marketing campaigns



I'd like GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and other appropriate tracking set up properly.



CallRail also needs to be implemented correctly so the tracking numbers don't create problems with our local SEO or our actual business phone number.



Ultimately, I'd like to be able to follow a lead as closely as possible from:



**Where they found us → what page they landed on → whether they called or filled out a form → estimate → sold job**



I'm much more interested in knowing which marketing actually produces roofing jobs and revenue than simply knowing how many people visited the website.



### Forms and Lead Generation



The website needs to be designed to turn visitors into leads.



We will need properly designed and trackable contact forms, quote request forms, click-to-call buttons and other calls to action.



Forms should work very well on mobile and have good spam protection without making them frustrating for legitimate customers.



### Easy to Keep Updating



We will probably have the same person or team who builds the website continue working on it afterwards.



I'm not highly technical and don't personally want to spend a lot of time managing the website.



I'd rather have someone reliable who understands what we're trying to accomplish and can keep adding projects, photos, case studies, pages and improvements for us.



The website should therefore be designed so these updates are efficient and don't require rebuilding everything every time we add something.



### Future AI-Assisted Updating



I expect AI to become a bigger part of managing websites over the next few years.



I'd like the website built so AI can eventually help our developer with things such as creating project pages from job information and photos, drafting case studies, organizing images, updating existing information, creating metadata, improving internal linking, identifying outdated information and finding SEO opportunities.



I don't expect everything to be automated immediately. I simply don't want the website built in a way that prevents us from taking advantage of AI as the technology improves.



### Security, Backups and Ownership



The website needs proper security and automatic backups.



I'd also like a staging area where larger changes can be tested before they are made live.



Our company needs to own and have administrator access to the domain, hosting, website, source code, content, photos, analytics, Search Console, Tag Manager, CallRail and other important accounts.



If we ever need to change developers in the future, another qualified developer should be able to take over the website.



### Ongoing Work



For the right person, I see this as a long-term opportunity rather than just a one-time website build.



After launch, there will be ongoing work such as:



- Adding completed projects

- Adding and organizing photos and videos

- Creating case studies

- Adding and improving content

- Technical SEO

- Local SEO

- Monitoring search performance

- Monitoring conversions and leads

- Improving website speed

- Improving conversion rates

- Keeping the website current as Google and AI search change



I'm looking for someone who takes some pride in continually improving what they've built rather than finishing a website and disappearing.



### Working Hours / Communication



We are located in Vancouver, Canada.



You can work your normal hours in the Philippines, but we do require some overlap with our working day so communication doesn't become difficult because of the time difference.



**You must be available from 8:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. Vancouver time on working days.**



Outside of those hours, you can generally work the schedule that works best for you.



Good communication is important to us. We need to be able to have conversations, review work and deal with questions without having to wait until the following day every time.



Please confirm in your application that you can consistently work these overlapping hours.



### When You Apply



Please don't send me a generic application.



I'd like you to answer the following:



1. What would you build this website on and why?



2. How would you make it extremely fast?



3. How would you build SEO into the website from the beginning rather than adding it afterwards?



4. What would you do differently today because of AI search?



5. How would you organize our roofing services, projects, case studies and neighbourhood pages?



6. How would you make it efficient to continually add new projects, photos and videos as our project library grows?



7. Have you worked with CallRail, GA4 and Google Tag Manager? Please explain your experience.



8. How would you track our calls and form leads back to where they originally came from?



9. What experience do you have with local SEO for home-service businesses?



10. How would you prepare the website for future AI-assisted updating?



11. Are you interested in continuing to manage, update and improve the website after it's launched?



12. Please send me three websites you've personally worked on and tell me specifically what you did on each one.



13. What tools do you use to test website speed and technical SEO?



14. What is your hourly rate?



15. Roughly how long do you think the initial website would take to build?



16. Please confirm that you can be available between **8:30 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. Vancouver time** on working days.



Please put **ROOFING 2027** at the top of your application so I know you've actually read the posting.



I'm not necessarily looking for the cheapest person. I'm looking for someone knowledgeable, reliable and easy to work with who we can hopefully have a long-term relationship with.



If you think I'm approaching something the wrong way or there's a better way to accomplish what I'm trying to do, I'm also interested in hearing your recommendations.

title: We're Hiring: Full-Time Video Editor!
description:
About Us

Alien Prints is a fast-growing custom apparel company based in Addison, Illinois. We produce 200+ orders per month of screen-printed, embroidered, and DTF-transferred custom apparel for construction companies, service businesses, and organizations across the US.



We're searching for a creative and detail-oriented Full-Time Video Editor who can turn ideas into engaging visual content. From social media clips to marketing campaigns, you'll play a key role in creating videos that captivate audiences and elevate our brand.



Job Requirements: Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design



Job Overview

The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week



Recruitment Process:

I. Initial Interview

II. Activity Video (Applicant must complete the activity video)

III. Final Interview



NOTE: Previous applicant need NOT TO APPLY.

title: Creative Brand Growth & Social Media Assistant
description:
Remote | Approximately 25 Hours Per Week

Weekly Pay: $100 USD Fixed

Availability Required: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time



About the Position



I am looking for a highly motivated, creative, and self-driven Brand & Social Media Assistant to join a growing product based ecommerce business on a long term basis.



This position combines graphic design, social media, branding, creative strategy, and general business improvement.



I already have an established professional brand identity, including logos, typography, colors, patterns, templates, and overall visual direction. I am not looking for someone to create a new brand from scratch.



I am looking for someone who can quickly learn the existing business and brand, understand how everything works together, and actively help take it to the next level.



This is not a position where you will simply wait for me to send individual design assignments. I need someone who can think independently, identify opportunities, contribute ideas, and continuously look for ways to improve the business and brand.



Compensation & Schedule



The pay for this position is a fixed $100 USD per week.



This rate is set and is not negotiable.



Please only apply if you are comfortable with the compensation before submitting your application.



The expected workload is approximately 25 hours per week.



You must have flexible availability between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday through Friday.



You do not need to work continuously throughout this entire window, but your schedule must overlap enough that you are reasonably available for communication, assignments, feedback, revisions, and time sensitive needs throughout the Pacific Time workday.



Ability to Learn and Ramp Quickly



One of the most important requirements for this position is the ability to absorb information quickly.



There will be a significant amount to learn when you first begin, including:



• Brand guidelines

• Design preferences

• Existing templates

• Product types

• Social media processes

• Product launches

• Previous designs

• Customer communication styles

• Business processes

• Marketing strategies

• Different types of announcements and content



I need someone who can digest this information, retain it, and begin applying it quickly.



I do not want to repeatedly explain the same processes, preferences, or instructions.



You should be able to review previous examples, understand feedback, recognize patterns, and apply what you have learned when approaching future assignments.



As you become familiar with the business, you should require less direction and become increasingly independent.



Understand and Elevate the Brand



Following the brand guide is only the starting point.



I am looking for someone who can genuinely understand the brand and help elevate it.



You should understand why certain colors, typography, layouts, graphics, and visual elements work rather than simply copying elements from the brand guide into every design.



Your work should help make the overall brand feel:



• More recognizable

• More cohesive

• More polished

• More professional

• More intentional

• More premium

• More consistent across platforms



I want someone who can creatively expand the existing branding while still respecting the established identity.



You should also be comfortable experimenting with different brand elements, layouts, and concepts rather than making every design look the same.



Independent Work Is Required



I am specifically looking for someone who can work independently.



I do not want to babysit, micromanage, or constantly tell you what you should be doing next.



I will provide priorities, information, deadlines, feedback, and direction when needed. However, you should be capable of managing your responsibilities without constant supervision.



You should be able to:



• Take ownership of assignments

• Determine appropriate next steps

• Make reasonable creative decisions

• Manage your own workload

• Keep track of deadlines

• Follow through without repeated reminders

• Review your own work before submitting it

• Recognize when something could be improved

• Solve smaller problems independently

• Ask thoughtful questions when clarification is genuinely needed



Questions are encouraged when something is unclear. However, I am not looking for someone who needs approval or instructions for every small decision.



Self-Driven Mindset



Being self-driven is essential for this role.



I want someone who actively thinks about the business while they are working rather than only completing a checklist.



You should regularly be thinking:



• What could we improve?

• What could make the brand look stronger?

• Is there a better way to present this product?

• What content should we be creating?

• What could improve the Instagram feed?

• Are there templates we should create?

• Is something inconsistent with the brand?

• Could an existing process or design be improved?

• Is there something the business is currently missing?

• What ideas could help increase brand awareness?



I want someone who notices opportunities and brings them forward.



You should feel comfortable saying, “I noticed this and think we could improve it by doing this.”



That type of initiative is highly valued.



What to Do When There Is No Active Assignment



There may occasionally be periods where there is no immediate launch graphic, announcement, or specific assignment waiting for you.



That does not mean there is nothing to work on.



If your assigned work is complete, I expect you to use your remaining working time productively by identifying opportunities for general improvement.



This could include:



• Reviewing the social media feed and identifying areas for improvement

• Developing new social media concepts

• Creating ideas for recurring content

• Improving or organizing Canva templates

• Reviewing existing branding for inconsistencies

• Brainstorming marketing ideas

• Researching relevant social media trends

• Developing packaging concepts

• Improving existing graphics

• Organizing creative assets

• Creating future templates

• Reviewing comparable brands for inspiration

• Brainstorming ways to improve the customer experience

• Identifying areas where the brand could feel more cohesive

• Developing ideas for future promotions or campaigns

• Suggesting improvements to existing processes



I should not need to constantly create busy work or tell you how to fill every working hour.



Part of this role is being able to identify meaningful work independently.



Bring Ideas for Growth



I am looking for someone who wants to contribute to the growth of the business, not simply execute designs.



You should be willing to bring your own ideas for:



• Growing brand awareness

• Improving social media

• Increasing engagement

• Creating stronger product launches

• Building customer loyalty

• Developing recurring content

• Improving packaging and presentation

• Creating a more memorable customer experience

• Making the brand more recognizable

• Improving existing marketing materials

• Exploring new creative opportunities



Not every idea will necessarily be implemented, but I want someone who actively thinks creatively and strategically about the company.



Creative & Social Media Responsibilities



Projects may include:



• Instagram feed posts

• Instagram Stories

• Reel covers

• Product launch graphics

• Presale announcements

• Restock announcements

• In hand sale graphics

• Coming soon posts

• Production updates

• Giveaways

• Event announcements

• Product and collection spotlights

• Informational graphics

• Website banners

•
 marketing graphics

• Packaging concepts

• Product backing cards

• Thank you cards

• Business cards

• Order inserts

• Event signage

• Vendor materials

• Promotional materials

• Reusable templates

• General brand development



Responsibilities will vary depending on launches, events, and current business priorities.



Canva Experience Is Essential



Strong Canva experience is required.



Canva is a major part of the workflow because many recurring materials need to remain editable and reusable by the team.



You should be comfortable:



• Designing professionally from scratch in Canva

• Working within existing Canva files

• Creating reusable templates

• Following established branding

• Organizing Canva projects properly

• Working with product photography

• Creating strong visual hierarchy

• Resizing and adapting designs

• Building files that other team members can easily edit



Canva should be a platform you are genuinely experienced designing in.



Adobe Experience



Experience with Adobe Illustrator is highly preferred for more advanced creative needs, including:



• Vector artwork

• Packaging layouts

• Print collateral

• Brand assets

• Product materials

• Preparing professional print files



Experience with Adobe Express is also preferred for digital content, resizing, social media assets, and quick creative adaptations.



Social Media Knowledge



Strong familiarity with Instagram and social media content is important.



You should understand how to create an overall recognizable social presence rather than simply designing individual posts.



You should be comfortable thinking about:



• Feed cohesion

• Brand recognition

• Visual storytelling

• Product presentation

• Engagement

• Promotional strategy

• Content variety

• Recurring content ideas

• Social media trends

• Creative launch concepts



I expect you to contribute ideas for social media rather than relying entirely on me to determine what should be posted.



Communication



WhatsApp is required and will be the primary form of day to day communication.



You should:



• Check messages regularly during your working availability

• Be reasonably responsive during Pacific Time

• Communicate clearly

• Provide progress updates when appropriate

• Tell me about potential delays before deadlines are missed

• Ask questions when something is genuinely unclear

• Communicate proactively rather than waiting for me to follow up



Strong communication and reliability are extremely important.



AI Usage



I am not looking for someone who relies heavily on AI generated content.



AI may occasionally be used as a supporting tool when appropriate, but it should not replace your own creativity, design skills, judgment, research, or original thinking.



Your work should feel intentionally designed and specific to the brand rather than heavily AI generated.



The same expectation applies to your application.



If your application is primarily AI generated and does not accurately reflect your normal communication style, creative thinking, or actual standard of work, you will not be considered.



I want to understand who I am actually hiring. Your application, portfolio, and any test work should genuinely represent your own abilities and the quality of work I can expect from you if hired.



The Right Person for This Role



This position is best suited for someone who is:



• A fast learner

• Highly self-driven

• Creative

• Proactive

• Independent

• Resourceful

• Reliable

• Organized

• Detail oriented

• Responsive

• Curious

• Comfortable taking ownership

• Able to understand and follow brand guidelines

• Able to develop ideas without being prompted

• Comfortable receiving constructive feedback

• Able to apply previous feedback to future projects

• Interested in helping grow a business long term



This position may not be the right fit if you prefer to:



• Wait for detailed instructions before beginning anything

• Have every task individually assigned

• Require frequent supervision

• Ask for approval on every small creative decision

• Only complete the exact task assigned and nothing beyond it

• Need constant reminders about deadlines or responsibilities



How to Apply



A portfolio is mandatory to be considered for this position.



Your application must include:



• A working link to your portfolio

• Examples that accurately represent your current design ability

• Examples of social media design work

• Canva examples, if available

• Branding or brand development work

• Your experience with Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Express

• Confirmation that you can maintain flexible availability between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM Pacific Time

• Confirmation that you understand and accept the fixed $100 USD weekly compensation



Please test your portfolio link before submitting your application.



If the portfolio link is broken, private, requires access approval, or otherwise cannot be viewed, your application may not be reviewed.



Any application submitted without a portfolio will be immediately disregarded.



Please make sure that the work included in your portfolio genuinely represents work you created and the level of quality you can consistently produce.



Applications that appear heavily AI generated, generic, or inconsistent with the applicant’s actual portfolio and standard of work will not be considered.



The $100 USD weekly compensation is fixed and non-negotiable. Please do not apply if this rate does not work for you.



I am ultimately looking for someone who can become a trusted creative extension of the business: someone who learns quickly, understands the brand, takes initiative, contributes ideas, and continually looks for ways to make the company better without needing to be told what to do every step of the way.

title: Operations & Meta Ads Specialist
description:
I am looking for an operations and data specialist with a marketing agency background to own the health of our systems and manage our clients'
 (Meta) Ads. You'll make sure no client or team member falls through the cracks, keep workflows and automations running, and turn daily data into decisions. Nobody on our team has deep ads experience, so you'll be our in-house expert: running ad accounts, reading the numbers, and telling us what to do next.



You'll start by learning our systems end-to-end, documenting them, and supporting our current operations lead, then grow into owning operations outright. This is a hands-on role. You won't just delegate work. You'll do the work and make the system better every week.



What You'll Do



Manage Meta Ads accounts. Build, launch, and optimize
 and Instagram campaigns for our clients, including audiences, budgets, creatives, and testing. Keep an eye on spend and results every day.

Report on ad performance. Track leads, cost per lead, conversions, and trends. Spot what's working and what isn't, and explain what to change and why.

Run daily data reviews. Monitor KPIs across sales, placements, retention, performance, and ads, and deliver a weekly report covering what the data says and what we should do about it.

Monitor client and staff communications. Stay on top of activity across clients and team members, spot red flags early (a client going quiet, a staff member slipping, an unresolved issue), and act on them before they escalate.

Own the pipeline. Track every client from onboarding through retention and make sure nobody is missed, stalled, or forgotten.

Manage ClickUp. Build and maintain workflows, assign tasks across departments, set deadlines, and make sure work actually gets completed.

Maintain automations. Monitor CRM and workflow automations, catch failures fast, and fix them or escalate them.

Document everything. Build and maintain SOPs for every back-end process, including how we run and report on ads, so no knowledge lives in one person's head.

Improve systems with AI. Use AI tools to cut manual work, speed up reporting, and improve accuracy.



What You Bring



Marketing agency background, or proven experience managing clients' ad accounts and ad data.

Hands-on
 (Meta) Ads Manager experience: campaign setup, optimization, and reading performance metrics.

3+ years in operations, RevOps, marketing operations, or business analytics.

Strong ClickUp experience, including workflows, automations, dashboards, and task management at scale.

CRM experience, with GoHighLevel strongly preferred.

Real data skills: spreadsheets, dashboards, spotting trends, and turning numbers into recommendations.

Hands-on use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in daily work.

Notion experience, which is a plus for supporting system migrations.

Zapier, Make, or similar tools are a plus.

Obsessive attention to detail. You notice the client who hasn't responded in 10 days or the team member whose updates stopped, and you make a move before anyone asks.

An owner mentality: you execute, you follow through, and you don't wait to be told.



First 90 Days



Days 1–30: Learn every back-end system and gain full access to it, including all client ad accounts and reporting. Start the SOP library.

Days 31–60: Take over day-to-day management of the Meta Ads accounts. Own the daily data review and weekly KPI report, including ad performance. Have zero missed clients.

Days 61–90: Ship at least 2 data-backed system or automation improvements, including at least one that improves ad results or ad reporting. Be able to run operations independently.



Please send your CV/Portfolio and short audio/video about your experience.

title: Real-Time Vehicle Dispatch Specialist
description:
We’re hiring our first dedicated Dispatchers to support our growing operations, particularly on a network of autonomous vehicles and food-delivery robots across U.S. markets. You’ll take ownership of day-to-day dispatch including monitoring live fleet operations, coordinating with field teams, troubleshooting issues as they happen, and helping build dispatch workflows that will support the operation as it scales. 



You’ll be working across multiple systems and communication channels, keeping track of what’s happening across different markets and jumping in when something needs attention. You’ll work closely with field operators and internal teams, make quick calls when issues come up, and speak directly with customers when needed. 



This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable making quick decisions, switching between different tools, and working with both internal teams and external customers. You’ll be working closely with U.S.-based field teams every shift, so previous experience supporting U.S. operations remotely is a strong plus. Since this function is still being built, you’ll also have a real opportunity to help shape the workflows, escalation paths, and processes that the team will use as it grows.



What You'll Do

- Monitor fleet activity and alert channels across multiple platforms and markets, tracking robot and vehicle locations, battery levels, active tasks, and delivery status.

- Own operational issues through resolution by identifying and prioritizing issues as they arise, including stalled or immobilized robots, unsafe conditions, missed tasks, and deliveries that fall off schedule.

- Contact the assigned field operator to resolve the issue, and follow established escalation procedures when they do not respond within the required timeframe.

- Coordinate backup coverage when the assigned operator is unavailable so that fleet operations continue without interruption.

- Continuously triage incoming alerts, messages, and fleet data, determining what requires immediate action and what can be handled through normal workflows.

- Prioritize and coordinate field service activity across markets, including battery swaps, robot recoveries, fleet interventions, and other service stops.

- Handle calls from drivers and supervisors on active runs who are unable to locate a delivery address or reach a customer, and resolve the issue on their behalf.

- Contact customers directly to confirm delivery locations, obtain access instructions, or complete a drop off.

- Document each i
, the actions taken, and any details relevant to future operations - such as gate codes, difficult access points, and recurring problem locations - and help pinpoint recurring patterns that can improve future workflows and customer technology.

- Contribute to the development of dispatch procedures, escalation paths, and operational documentation as the operation grows.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator - Solutions & Delivery
description:
Senior Salesforce Administrator | Work From Home | Full Time



We’re OpenCorp. For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped everyday Australians build wealth through property with the right strategy, advice and ongoing support. 



We’re looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to join our Technology Team. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can do more than administer Salesforce — you’ll work with stakeholders to understand business problems, design smart solutions and take them all the way from discovery through to delivery. 



You’ll play a key role in how Salesforce supports our business, balancing day-to-day platform administration with solution design, project delivery, continuous improvement and mentoring other Salesforce Administrators. 



What you’ll be doing:



- Owning day-to-day Salesforce administration, including users, permissions, security, reports, dashboards, data quality and platform health 

- Managing and resolving Salesforce support requests while looking beyond the immediate issue to identify opportunities for improvement 

- Working directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, processes and desired outcomes 

- Leading discovery sessions and translating business requirements into practical Salesforce solutions 

- Designing and building scalable solutions using Salesforce Flow, validation rules, formulas, approvals, custom objects and other declarative tools 

- Managing Salesforce projects from discovery and solution design through build, testing, UAT, deployment and post-release support 

- Reviewing Salesforce solutions developed by other team members to ensure quality, maintainability and consistency 

- Helping strengthen our Salesforce DevOps and release-management practices 

- Supporting integrations, APIs, data migrations and other connected business platforms 

- Creating clear solution, technical, process and user documentation 

- Mentoring Salesforce Administrators and sharing knowledge across the Technology Team 

- Continuously identifying ways Salesforce can reduce manual work, improve data quality and create a better user experience 



We’re looking for someone with 

- At least 4 years of demonstrated Salesforce experience, including senior administration or consulting responsibilities 

- Salesforce Certified Administrator certification 

- Salesforce Platform App Builder certification or equivalent demonstrated capability 

- Advanced hands-on experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative automation 

- Proven experience taking Salesforce projects from discovery and requirements through build, UAT and deployment 

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and confidently leading solution discussions 

- Practical experience with Salesforce DevOps, source control, structured deployments or release-management tools 

- Experience conducting peer reviews and applying Salesforce development standards 

- Experience supporting integrations, data migrations or connected business systems 

- Strong problem-solving skills with the confidence to challenge a request and understand the real business problem before building a solution 

- Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders 

- A strong focus on quality, documentation, scalability and long-term maintainability 



Highly regarded 

- Salesforce Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Sales Cloud Consultant certification 

- Experience with Gearset, Copado, Flosum, Salesforce DevOps Center or similar tools 

- Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, outbound messages or native Salesforce integrations 

- Experience with Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot), Sales Engagement, Experience Cloud, Agentforce or Data Cloud 

- Experience mentoring Salesforce Administrators or helping improve technical standards across a team 

- Experience working remotely with Australian, UK or US stakeholders 

- Exposure to Agile delivery, Jira and Confluence 



About you 

- You’re an experienced Salesforce professional who likes understanding why something needs to change before d
 how to build it. 

- You’re comfortable getting hands-on in Salesforce, but you can also step back and think about the bigger picture — the business process, user experience, data, integrations and long-term impact of a solution. 

- You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions constructively and take ownership of your work from initial discovery through to delivery. You care about building solutions that are scalable, maintainable and genuinely useful, and you enjoy helping other team members strengthen their Salesforce capability along the way. 



Salary and Benefits

- Government-mandated benefits

- Competitive monthly salary based on experience (inclusive of PHP 7,500 non-taxable allowance) 

- HMO coverage after six-month probation
