title: Remote Accounts Receivable & Finance Administrator (Xero)
description:
ABOUT US

JB Industrial Electrics (JBI Electrical) is a commercial and industrial electrical contractor in regional Victoria, Australia. We run Electrical, Solar and Precast divisions across four branches, and our field team is growing fast.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a full-time, remote, Philippines-based Accounts Receivable & Finance Administrator to join our offshore admin team. You will own invoicing, debtor follow-up, bank reconciliations, supplier and customer setup, and staff onboarding. You will work alongside an experienced Filipino colleague and report to our Finance & Operations lead in Australia.



This is a long-term role in a business that is automating its admin. You will help shape new workflows, not just enter data.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Invoice completed jobs and progress claims, and chase project managers for missing details.

- Receipt customer payments and follow up overdue accounts.

- Reconcile all bank accounts daily, plus company cards and expense receipts monthly.

- Enter non-purchase-order bills such as utilities and subscriptions.

- Create and maintain supplier and customer records, following strict verification controls.

- Onboard new staff: employee records, tax and super forms, system access and induction scheduling.

- Maintain the employee licences and tickets register, and flag upcoming expiries.

- Support our business development and operations managers with admin tasks.

- Keep our job management database accurate and up to date.

- Prepare month-end and BAS working papers for review.



MUST HAVE

- At least 2 years' experience in bookkeeping or accounts for businesses in Australia, NZ, the US, the UK or Canada.

- Hands-on Xero experience, including bank reconciliation and invoicing.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures exactly.

- Clear written and spoken English.

- Confidence to follow up managers, customers and suppliers until issues are resolved.

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and availability Monday to Friday, 8am to 4pm Philippine time.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Australian businesses.

- Knowledge of Australian GST, BAS, superannuation and onboarding requirements.

- Background in construction, electrical or trade services businesses.

- Hands-on Simpro experience (invoicing, purchase orders, database maintenance). We will train the right person if you have not used it.

- Experience with Ezzybill or Hubdoc.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term remote role.

- Salary: AUD 600 per week (about PHP 112,000 per month at current exchange rates).

- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 4pm Philippine time.

- Training in our systems and procedures, and a supportive team.

- Exposure to modern finance automation as we move to a single integrated platform.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short cover letter explaining your Xero and accounts receivable experience. Start your application with the words "JBI Finance" so we know you have read this ad in full. Applications without these words will not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a 20-minute practical test covering bank reconciliation and invoicing before the interview.

title: Part Time Follow Up and Appointment Setter
description:
Part-Time Automotive Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Setter

Part-Time Virtual Assistant – Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Setting  

25 Hours Per Week  

Schedule:U.S. Central Time  

Location:Remote – Philippines



ABOUT US

EONE Auto Group / 
 is a growing automotive dealership in Arlington, Texas.

We generate a large number of leads through radio advertising, online marketing, credit applications, referrals, and our existing customer database.

We already have team members responsible for handling our newest incoming leads.

We are hiring an additional VA whose primary responsibility will be FOLLOW-UP AND PRODUCING RESULTS.



This is NOT simply an administrative VA position.



We need someone who can confidently speak with customers, stay persistent, and turn old opportunities into real dealership appointments.



VERY IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:

STRONG SPOKEN ENGLISH

STRONG WRITTEN ENGLISH

Clear and professional communication

 Confidence speaking with U.S.-based customers

- Ability to hold a natural phone conversation

- Ability to handle objections

- Ability to work independently

- **PROVEN ABILITY TO PRODUCE RESULTS**

- Strong work ethic and accountability

- Ability to meet performance expectations consistently



We are not looking for someone who simply completes tasks.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO PRODUCES APPOINTMENTS, CUSTOMER SHOWS, AND RESULTS.



WORK SCHEDULE



All hours are based on U.S. Central Time (Texas)

Monday: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM  

Tuesday: 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM  

Wednesday: 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM  

Thursday: 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM  

Friday: 12:00 PM – 4:00 PM  

Saturday: OFF  

Sunday: OFF



Total: 25 hours per week



Saturday and Sunday are consecutive days off.



You must be available consistently during these scheduled hours.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Your job is simple:

TURN OLD LEADS INTO APPOINTMENTS.



Our existing VAs handle incoming/new leads.



You will focus primarily on customers who have already contacted us but have not yet purchased.



These may include:



- Customers we have not been able to reach

- Customers who submitted credit applications

- Customers who started but did not finish an application

- Customers who were approved but never visited

- Customers who missed appointments

- Customers who previously said they needed more time

- Customers concerned about their down payment

- Customers waiting until payday

- Radio leads who never came into the dealership

- Leads from the past 3–30 days

- Older leads that need to be reactivated

- Previous customers for referral opportunities



You should be comfortable hearing **“no,” “not right now,” or “I don't have enough money down”** and continuing the conversation professionally.



## DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



You will:



- Make high-volume outbound calls

- Send follow-up text messages

- Respond to customers who reply

- Schedule dealership appointments

- Confirm appointments

- Follow up with no-shows

- Re-engage customers who stopped responding

- Follow up on incomplete credit applications

- Contact customers with down-payment concerns

- Update every customer interaction in our CRM

- Maintain accurate notes

- Follow dealership scripts and processes

- Provide management with daily appointment results

- Communicate with the sales team when customers are coming into the dealership



## PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



This is a **RESULTS-DRIVEN POSITION**.



We expect approximately:



**30–40 outbound calls per working hour during dedicated calling periods.**



We measure:



- Calls

- Conversations

- Follow-ups completed

- Appointments set

- Confirmed appointments

- Kept appointments / customer shows

- Sales generated from follow-up

- Overall ability to produce measurable results



We care more about **QUALITY APPOINTMENTS THAT ACTUALLY SHOW UP** than simply entering appointments into a CRM.



Activity is important, but results matter.



 30-DAY PROBATION PERIOD



The first **30 days of employment are considered a probationary period**.



During this period, we will evaluate:



- Attendance and reliability

- Spoken and written English

- Ability to communicate confidently with customers

- Call volume

- CRM accuracy

- Quality of follow-up

- Appointments generated

- Customer shows

- Ability to produce results

- Coachability

- Overall performance



Successful completion of the 30-day probation period is required to continue into the regular team bonus program.



TEAM SALES BONUS



AFTER SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETING THE 30-DAY PROBATION PERIOD:



You will become eligible to receive:



### **$1 BONUS FOR EVERY VEHICLE THE DEALERSHIP SELLS**



This is a team-based bonus.



For example:

40 vehicles sold = $40 bonus

50 vehicles sold = $50 bonus

60 vehicles sold = $60 bonus



The bonus begins after successful completion of the probationary period and is designed to reward team members as the dealership grows.



## WHO WE WANT



We are looking for someone who is:

Highly reliable

Excellent in spoken English

Excellent in written English

Energetic on the phone

Confident speaking with customers

Persistent without being rude

Comfortable making a lot of outbound calls

Comfortable texting customers

Organized

Competitive

Coachable

Positive

Results-oriented

Self-motivated

Comfortable being measured by performance

Able to follow scripts while still sounding natural

Able to consistently produce appointments and customer shows



Automotive experience is helpful but NOT required.



Previous experience in automotive dealerships, appointment setting, BDC, lead generation, telemarketing, outbound sales, call centers, collections, customer retention, real estate lead follow-up, insurance sales, or high-volume phone sales is a major plus.



## TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



- Reliable high-speed internet

- Reliable computer

- Quality headset

- Quiet working environment

- Backup internet option preferred

- Ability to work U.S. Central Time hours



Experience using CRM systems is preferred.



We currently use systems such as AutoClick, RingCentral, and other automotive lead-management tools.



Training will be provided on our specific process.



IMPORTANT

This position involves A LOT OF CALLING and is heavily focused on results.

If you dislike making outbound calls, have difficulty communicating clearly in English, or prefer a position where performance is not measured, this is probably not the right position for you.

If you enjoy speaking with customers, overcoming objections, following up aggressively, and turning old opportunities into appointments, we want to hear from you.



 HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:

1. Your name

2. Your previous outbound calling or appointment-setting experience

3. How many outbound calls you have typically made per day

4. Examples of results you produced in a previous sales, calling, or appointment-setting role

5. Your experience using CRM systems

6. Your internet speed

7. Your computer/headset setup

8. Confirmation that you can work the schedule listed above in U.S. Central Time

9. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at appointment setting



At the beginning of your application, write:

I CAN TURN OLD LEADS INTO APPOINTMENTS.

Applications that do not include this statement may not be considered.

We are looking for someone who wants a stable long-term opportunity and is interested in growing with our company.

title: Client Relationship & Operations Manager
description:
# Client Relationship & Operations Manager



**Full-Time Remote Position (Philippines)**



Established U.S.-based home service company seeking a highly organized, proactive, and professional **Client Relationship & Operations Manager** to become a long-term part of a fast-growing operation.



This is **NOT an entry-level virtual assistant role**.



We are looking for someone capable of handling real operational responsibility, customer communication, scheduling coordination, follow-ups, organization, and administrative oversight in a fast-paced environment.



If you require constant supervision, struggle with communication, or are uncomfortable taking initiative and ownership, this role will not be a good fit.



We are looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, highly responsive, and capable of helping maintain structure and organization across multiple moving parts of the business.



## Work Schedule



* Monday through Friday

* 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

* 1-hour lunch break

* 40 hours per week



Applicants **MUST** be fully available during U.S. Eastern business hours.



This is a real-time operational role, not passive task work.



You are expected to remain online, responsive, and immediately available during working hours for:



* Phone calls

* Customer communication

* Scheduling updates

* Internal team coordination

* Operational support

* Video calls when needed



## Communication Requirements



Applicants must be comfortable being on camera and participating in live video calls during work hours.



There will be situations where management or field staff may initiate video calls to:



* Discuss live field situations

* Review projects in real time

* Coordinate customer concerns

* Assist with active jobsite situations

* Communicate face-to-face regarding operational matters



Professional appearance, strong communication skills, and comfort on camera are required.



## Compensation



Starting compensation is **$5 to $6 USD per hour**, depending on experience, qualifications, communication skills, and interview performance.



In addition to hourly pay, this position includes a **generous performance-based incentive program** connected to specific operational and performance benchmarks.



Performance incentives are tracked and calculated **weekly**, giving strong performers the opportunity to increase their income quickly.



A successful Brand Manager who consistently meets or exceeds performance expectations should be capable of earning an effective income of **$10+ per hour** through a combination of hourly pay and incentives.



Additional compensation growth is available as performance, responsibility, and the company continue to grow.



We are looking for a long-term team member, not a temporary freelancer.



## Core Responsibilities



### Client Relationship Management



* Answer inbound phone calls professionally

* Respond to customer texts and
s quickly

* Maintain strong customer communication and follow-up

* Assist with scheduling and appointment confirmations

* Follow up with leads, estimates, and existing customers

* Handle customer questions and concerns professionally

* Help maintain an excellent customer experience

* Ensure customers do not get forgotten or lost during the sales and service process



### Operations Coordination



* Coordinate calendars, schedules, and field operations

* Organize and track ongoing tasks and follow-ups

* Maintain accurate CRM notes and customer records

* Monitor pending estimates, appointments, and customer opportunities

* Ensure important operational details do not fall through the cracks

* Coordinate internally with management, office staff, and field crews

* Help improve workflows and organization throughout the company

* Identify problems and help find solutions before they become larger issues



### Administrative & Management Support



* Assist management with organization and operational oversight

* Track pending items, priorities, and project updates

* Maintain structure, accountability, and communication

* Help management stay organized in a fast-paced environment

* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities without requiring constant supervision



### Sales Follow-Up & Customer Retention



* Consistently follow up with leads and open estimates

* Help move potential customers through the decision-making process

* Reconnect with customers who have not responded

* Follow up after completed projects

* Assist with review requests and customer retention

* Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional services



This is not an aggressive sales position, but strong follow-up and communication are a major part of the role.



### Social Media & Marketing Coordination



* Organize project photos and videos

* Assist with social media scheduling and posting

* Coordinate customer review requests

* Respond to messages and engagement when needed

* Help maintain brand consistency and online presence



## Required Qualifications



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Clear and confident phone communication

* Strong organizational skills

* High attention to detail

* Fast response time

* Strong customer service skills

* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

* Comfortable participating in live video calls

* Professional appearance and communication

* Ability to think critically and solve problems independently

* Ability to prioritize responsibilities without constant direction

* Strong follow-up habits

* Reliable internet connection

* Quiet and professional work environment

* Ability to take ownership and accept accountability



## Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is strongly preferred:



* Operations coordination

* Scheduling and dispatching

* CRM management

* Customer service

* Lead follow-up or sales support

* Social media management

* Executive or administrative support

* Workflow and systems management

* Home service or construction industry



Previous experience working directly with U.S.-based customers is a major plus.



## Who This Position Is For



We are building a serious operation and looking for serious professionals.



This position is best suited for someone who enjoys:



* Organization

* Customer communication

* Follow-up

* Problem-solving

* Operational structure

* Improving systems

* Taking responsibility

* Helping businesses grow



This is **NOT a passive assistant role**.



We are looking for someone who can become a trusted operational asset, take ownership of their responsibilities, and become a long-term part of the company.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience

3. A **1–2 minute video introduction** so we can see and hear how you communicate

4. A brief description of your experience with CRM systems, scheduling, customer communication, and follow-up

5. An example of a system, workflow, or process you helped improve in a previous position



In your application subject line, include the phrase:



**“Structure Creates Growth”**

title: DM Appointment Setter (Full-Time, Graveyard Shift – US Hours)
description:
I'm looking for a full-time DM Setter (an appointment setter who works through direct messages) to handle my lead conversations and book appointments. You'll be messaging leads through DMs, following up consistently, and getting qualified leads booked onto my calendar. This is a long-term role, and I will train you.



SCHEDULE - GRAVEYARD SHIFT (PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING)

- 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday to Friday

- This covers U.S. business hours (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Central Time)

- 40 hours per week

- You must be able to commit to this schedule consistently. Please only apply if you can genuinely work these hours long-term.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Message leads: Start and carry on conversations with new leads through DMs

- Set appointments: Qualify interested leads and book them onto my calendar

- Follow up: Consistently follow up with leads who haven't replied or haven't booked yet

- Forward questions: Pass along any questions you can't answer so I can respond

- Keep track of your conversations and booked appointments so nothing slips through the cracks



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- Excellent written English - clear, friendly, natural, and professional

- Fast, reliable responder who can handle multiple conversations at once

- Organized and consistent with follow-ups

- Experience in appointment setting, DM setting, chat support, or sales is a plus and will be reflected in your rate, but I will train the right person

- Stable internet, a reliable computer or laptop, and a quiet place to work

- Honest, dependable, and able to work independently during the graveyard shift



PAY AND BENEFITS

- $4 to $6 USD per hour, depending on experience

- Plus commissions (structure will be discussed during the hiring process)

- 13th month pay

- Full training provided

- Full-time, stable, long-term position (40 hours per week)

- Weekends off



HOW TO APPLY

To show me you've read this post, start your application with the word "SETTER" and include:

1. Confirmation that you can work 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday to Friday

2. A short summary of any appointment setting, DM, chat support, or sales experience you have (if you have none, that's okay - tell me why you'd be good at this)

3. A sample message you would send to a lead who showed interest but then stopped replying



Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be considered.



I'm looking to hire soon, so if this sounds like you, apply today.

title: Part-Time Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Mango & Marmalade Stories is a UK children’s publishing brand creating books and stories around culture, family, identity and belonging.



I’m looking for an experienced, creative Digital Marketing & Content Specialist who understands both good design and what makes marketing convert.



Experience I’m specifically looking for



You should have proven experience in:



* Graphic design and creating high-quality social media content

* Children’s books, publishing, children’s products or family/parent brands

* Instagram and
 marketing

* Meta Ads setup, testing and optimisation

* Creating strong hooks, copy and calls to action

*
 marketing and simple sales funnels

* Canva or similar design tools

* Understanding CTR, CPC, conversions and ROAS

* Using performance data to improve both organic and paid content



What you’ll do



You’ll help me turn existing illustrations, books, audiobooks, videos and founder content into marketing campaigns that generate interest and sales.



This will include creating social posts and reels, planning content, writing copy, running and optimising small-budget Meta campaigns, supporting
 campaigns and funnels, and reviewing performance to understand what we should do differently next time.



You’ll also occasionally research and build targeted databases of bookshops, schools, libraries, children’s organisations and other relevant partners for outreach.



You will not be responsible for website development or building landing pages. I already have a separate freelancer managing this.



The type of person I’m looking for



I don’t need someone who simply waits for instructions on what graphic to make.



I’d like someone who can look at a campaign and think:



Who are we trying to reach? Why would they care? What will make them stop? Why would they click? And how do we turn that attention into a sale?



Because we’re a small business, our advertising budgets are modest. I therefore particularly value someone who knows how to test carefully and optimise campaigns without wasting ad spend.



To apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio, particularly children’s, publishing or family-focused work

2. Examples of social media graphics/reels you personally created

3. Examples of Meta campaigns you’ve personally managed and optimised

4. An example of a campaign that wasn’t performing and what you changed

5. Your experience with
 marketing and funnels





Please start your application with “Mango & Marmalade” and tell me briefly why you think you’d be a good fit for a children’s publishing brand.



Generic applications without a portfolio won’t be considered.

title: Media Buyer (Lead Generation | Performance-Focused)
description:
This role is posted by TRES on behalf of Restive Collective, one of the agencies we support. You’ll be hired by and work directly with the Restive Collective team.



About Restive Collective

Restive Collective is a Singapore-based agency that uses personal branding for lead generation. We work with founder-led, service-based businesses — coaches, consultants, gym owners and other experts — and turn their real stories into short-form video and carousel content that brings in qualified leads, not just views.



Our funnels are deliberately simple and proven: short-form video content → Meta ads → lead form or WhatsApp automation / landing page → booked conversation. Every client is spending real money every month, and your job is to make that money work.



Why This Role Is Different

This is not a branding or “boost post” role.



You’ll be working on:

Real lead-generation campaigns for real founders

Ad accounts with live monthly spend, reported and optimised daily

A tight, repeatable funnel where your decisions directly change lead volume and cost per lead

You’ll follow clear SOPs — and you’ll also be trusted to make judgment calls when the numbers call for it.

If you want to become a senior buyer who owns performance end-to-end, this role will stretch you in the right way.



What You’ll Do

Run and optimise conversion-focused Meta campaigns 
 & Instagram) across our client portfolio

Follow the daily media-buying routine: morning — check numbers, queue new ads, log and report; afternoon — optimise, analyse what’s working, recommend next moves

Own campaign health — monitor performance, flag issues early and escalate opportunities to the founder

Set up new client ad accounts (one-time setup per client) and launch new creative batches as they come from our script and video team

Support simple funnel setup where needed — landing page, VSL page and WhatsApp automation (we have a ready framework; no complex builds)

- Previous work-from-home experience required

- Reliable computer

- Quiet workspace

- Headset

- Reliable primary internet

- Backup internet required



VOICE / CUSTOMER SERVICE EXPERIENCE

At least 12 months of experience in one or more of the following is preferred:

- BPO / call center

- Voice customer service

- Receptionist

- Appointment setting

- Inbound/outbound calling

- Similar client-facing phone work

This should not be your first work-from-home position.



PROPERTY EXPERIENCE

Property-management or leasing experience is helpful but not required.

Experience with RentRedi, AppFolio, Buildium, leasing, maintenance coordination, Airbnb, or Furnished Finder is a plus.

Training will be provided on our property-management systems and procedures.



SCHEDULE

Monday–Friday, 4 hours per day. Candidates may propose a consistent 4-hour schedule between 8:00 AM and 3:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time. The final schedule will be agreed before hiring and should remain consistent. No overlapping employment or client work during the agreed 4-hour shift.



PAY

Starting pay is PHP 18,000–23,000/month, depending on demonstrated skills and relevant experience.

Candidates with limited property experience may start closer to PHP 18,000/month while learning our systems.

Candidates who already have useful leasing/property-operations experience and require less training may start higher in the range.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please follow ALL instructions below.

1. Subject Line

Use this subject line: PM
. Resume

Provide a direct Google Drive link to your resume in PDF format.

Make sure the file permissions allow us to view it.

3. Video

Finalists may be asked to complete a short paid skills assessment before an offer is made.

title: Rental Booking Host
description:
CAR RENTAL OPERATIONS, INVOICING & GHL ASSISTANT



Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity

Work Days: Thursday–Monday

Days Off: Tuesday & Wednesday

Schedule: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Central Time

Starting Pay: $300 USD/month — approximately ₱18,800 PHP/month

PHP equivalent will vary based on the exchange rate.



Philippine Schedule



Your working schedule is always based on Texas/U.S. Central Time.



While Texas is observing Daylight Saving Time:



9:00 AM–6:00 PM Central Time = approximately 10:00 PM–7:00 AM Philippine Time



When Texas returns to Standard Time:



9:00 AM–6:00 PM Central Time = approximately 11:00 PM–8:00 AM Philippine Time



The Philippines does not change clocks, but Texas does, so your Philippine working hours will change during the year.



Your regular days off are:



TUESDAY & WEDNESDAY



Please make sure this schedule works for you before applying.



⸻

 PLEASE READ THE PAY BEFORE APPLYING

This position starts at:



$300 USD PER MONTH



If you are currently looking for a higher starting salary, please do not apply.



We want to be respectful of your time and ours.



This opportunity is designed for someone who wants to:



LEARN • PROVE THEMSELVES • GROW • TAKE OWNERSHIP • BUILD A LONG-TERM POSITION



We are willing to train the right person.



You may have previous experience, but you will still need to learn our company, our procedures, our rental policies, our systems, our customers, and the way we operate.



Compensation increases are not automatic or guaranteed.



Growth is based on your:



Reliability • Performance • Accuracy • Responsibility • Communication • Leadership • Knowledge • Business Needs



We are looking for someone who wants to grow into a bigger role — not someone looking for a temporary position while searching for their next job.



⸻



WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

You will help us manage the daily operations of a growing U.S.-based car-rental company.



This is not a position where you simply wait for someone to give you random administrative tasks.



You will gradually be trained to help us control the rental operation.



That means knowing:



* Who is renting each vehicle

* Who has paid

* Who has not paid

* What each renter owes

* Which invoices are outstanding

* Which leads need follow-up

* Which customers need to be contacted

* What happened during previous conversations

* What information needs to be documented

* What needs management attention



We need someone who learns the business well enough to notice when something is wrong.



⸻



CUSTOMER SERVICE & RENTAL BOOKINGS

You may be responsible for:



* Answering incoming customer calls

* Returning missed calls

* Responding to text messages

* Speaking with prospective renters

* Explaining rental requirements

* Answering common rental questions

* Following up with interested leads

* Helping qualified customers move through the rental process

* Scheduling appointments

* Booking vehicle pickups

* Following up with customers who have not completed the process

* Updating renter information

* Documenting conversations

* Keeping customer records organized



You must be comfortable actually talking to people.



This is not a text-only position.



⸻



YOUR PHONE VOICE MATTERS — A LOT

You will regularly communicate with U.S.-based customers.



Your English must be:



CLEAR • NATURAL • CONFIDENT • FRIENDLY • PROFESSIONAL



You do not need to sound American.



You do need to be easy to understand and comfortable communicating professionally.



You must be willing to:



* Make outgoing calls

* Receive incoming calls

* Follow up with leads

* Speak with renters about money

* Remain professional when customers are frustrated

* Ask direct questions when necessary

* Communicate confidently without sounding rude or robotic



If you are extremely uncomfortable speaking on the phone, this position is probably not a good fit.



⸻



 DAILY RENTAL PAYMENT CONTROL



This is one of the most important responsibilities in the position.



Our rental customers may make payments seven days per week.



You will be trained to help monitor renter accounts and make sure our records stay accurate.



This may include:



* Checking renter payments

* Reviewing payment screenshots or confirmations

* Confirming manual payments have been properly recorded

* Identifying unpaid or partially paid accounts

* Reviewing outstanding balances

* Creating invoices

* Updating invoices

* Recording payments

* Maintaining renter payment ledgers

* Checking that required invoices were sent

* Sending professional payment reminders

* Calling or texting renters with missed payments

* Documenting promises to pay

* Updating account notes

* Flagging accounts that are becoming delinquent

* Escalating serious payment issues to management



We do not want someone who sees an unpaid account and simply leaves it there.



We need someone who notices it, documents it, follows the procedure, and communicates what is happening.



⸻



NIGHTLY PAYMENT CHECK

Our renter payment deadline is later than the regular daytime office schedule.



Because of this, on working days you may be responsible for a brief payment-control check around 9:15 PM U.S. Central Time.



This is separate from sitting online and working continuously all evening.



The purpose is to verify things such as:



* Who paid

* Who did not pay

* Which accounts require follow-up

* Whether payments were recorded correctly

* Whether an invoice or ledger needs to be updated

* Whether management needs to be notified



This is a car-rental operation. Payments and renters do not always operate on a perfect 9-to-5 schedule.



You must be reasonably comfortable with that reality.



⸻



 GOHIGHLEVEL — GHL



GoHighLevel is an important part of our operation.



You may be trained to:



* Update contacts

* Update customer records

* Update opportunities

* Move leads through pipeline stages

* Create tasks

* Schedule appointments

* Review conversations

* Send messages

* Update notes

* Help organize pipelines

* Monitor workflows

* Assist with automations

* Test automations

* Identify when an automation did not work correctly

* Help maintain customer follow-up systems



Previous GoHighLevel experience is helpful, but it is not required if you are highly trainable.



However, you must be comfortable learning software.



⸻



 INVOICING, RECORDS & BOOKKEEPING SUPPORT



You may also help maintain the administrative and financial records connected to our rental operation.



Tasks may include:



* Creating rental invoices

* Updating invoices

* Recording payments

* Maintaining renter ledgers

* Reviewing customer balances

* Organizing supporting documents

* Uploading financial records

* Helping organize payroll documents

* Uploading or organizing tax/payroll forms such as Form 941

* Organizing financial statements

* Assisting with bookkeeping-related administrative work

* Checking records for missing information

* Keeping company files organized



You are not expected to arrive knowing everything.



You are expected to learn.



⸻



WE CARE A LOT ABOUT MEMORY & RETENTION



We will train you.

But training does not mean your manager should have to teach the same process from the beginning every time you perform it.



We strongly prefer someone who:



* Takes detailed notes during training

* Creates their own checklists

* Reviews previous training

* Uses recorded training materials

* Remembers corrections

* Learns from mistakes

* Looks for the answer before immediately asking again

* Follows established procedures

* Can work independently after being trained

* Notices inconsistencies

* Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities



If we teach you something Thursday and you do not perform that task again until Monday, we expect you to review your training materials and notes before saying:



“I don’t remember.”



We want someone resourceful.



⸻



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO PAYS ATTENTION

A strong candidate does not only complete tasks.



They notice things.



For example:



If a renter normally pays daily and suddenly has not paid, you notice.



If an invoice amount does not match the renter ledger, you notice.



If someone promised to pay yesterday and still has not paid, you notice.



If a customer has called several times and nobody followed up, you notice.



If an automation should have sent something and did not, you notice.



If information is missing from an account, you notice.



That level of awareness is extremely valuable to us.



⸻



REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS

Because this is a remote position, you must be dependable without someone physically standing over you.



You should have:



* Reliable internet

* A dependable computer

* A quiet enough environment for professional customer calls

* Reliable electricity or a reasonable backup plan

* The ability to communicate with the team throughout your shift



You should also be comfortable using:



* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

*

* Messaging platforms

* CRM software

* Online invoicing systems

* Cloud-based business tools



⸻



OUR TEAM ENVIRONMENT

We work hard, but we are also human.



We laugh.



We joke.



We talk.



We ask questions.



We help each other.



We communicate throughout the day while getting the work done.



We want someone who is comfortable:



* Communicating with coworkers

* Participating in team conversations

* Asking thoughtful questions

* Helping teammates

* Receiving feedback

* Being corrected professionally

* Correcting mistakes

* Building positive working relationships



We do not expect perfection.



We do expect effort, honesty, accountability, improvement, and communication.



⸻



OCCASIONAL URGENT SITUATIONS



Car rentals sometimes involve situations that cannot conveniently wait until the next morning.



Examples could include:



* A renter with an urgent vehicle issue

* A payment problem

* A vehicle return issue

* An account requiring immediate escalation

* A serious customer situation



This does not mean you will constantly work outside your scheduled hours.



It does mean we need someone who understands this is an operations position and is reasonably willing to assist with a true urgent situation when necessary.



As your responsibility within the company grows, your role and compensation may grow with it.



If you require a position where you can never be contacted outside your working hours under any circumstances, this may not be the right opportunity.



⸻



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE LONG-TERM

We do not want to continuously train a new person every few months.



We want to find someone we can:



TRAIN • TRUST • DEVELOP • KEEP



Someone who eventually knows our operation extremely well.



Someone who becomes valuable because they understand:



Our customers.

Our vehicles.

Our payments.

Our systems.

Our procedures.

Our team.



If you are looking for somewhere you can learn, become more valuable, take on greater responsibility, and potentially grow with a company over time, we would like to hear from you.



⸻



 90-DAY PROBATIONARY PERIOD



All new hires begin with a 90-day probationary period.



During this period, we evaluate:



Attendance

Reliability

Communication

Phone Skills

English Communication

Memory & Retention

Learning Ability

Accuracy

Productivity

Work Quality

Initiative

Following Procedures

Problem Solving

Professionalism

Teamwork

Accountability

Overall Fit



Successful completion of probation is required before becoming a permanent long-term contractor.



⸻



 REQUIRED VIDEO INTRODUCTION

IF YOU DO NOT SUBMIT THE VIDEO, YOUR APPLICATION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Your video is part of your interview.



Please answer ALL 17 QUESTIONS.



1.



Tell us about yourself and your previous work experience.



2.



Why are you looking for a long-term position?



3.



What is the longest you have stayed with one employer or client, and why did you leave?



4.



Are you currently employed, freelancing, or working for other clients?



Please be honest.



5.



If hired, will this be your only full-time job?



If not, explain your other work commitments and schedule.



6.



Are you comfortable making and receiving phone calls with U.S.-based customers?



Tell us about your previous phone/customer-service experience.



7.



Tell us about a time you were responsible for something important without your manager constantly watching you.



What were you responsible for, and how did you make sure it was completed correctly?



8.



When someone trains you on a new process, what do you personally do to make sure you remember it?



9.



Imagine we train you on a task Thursday, but you do not need to perform that task again until Monday.



When Monday comes, you cannot remember every step.



What would you do?



10.



Tell us about something complicated you had to learn at a previous job.



How did you learn it, document it, and remember how to do it?



11.



Tell us about a mistake you made at work.



What happened, how did you handle it, and what did you do to prevent it from happening again?



12.



When working remotely, do you enjoy communicating and interacting with coworkers, or do you prefer working mostly independently?



Describe your personality at work.



13.



Our team works hard, but we also laugh, joke, communicate, ask questions, and interact throughout the day.



Would you enjoy being part of that kind of team? Why?



14.



Can you consistently work:



THURSDAY–MONDAY



9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. CENTRAL TIME



with Tuesday and Wednesday OFF?



Please confirm that you understand these hours will be overnight hours in the Philippines.



15.



Our rental payment deadline occurs later in the evening.



On your scheduled working days, are you willing and able to perform a brief payment-control check around 9:15 PM U.S. Central Time when required?



Please explain any limitations.



16.



This is a car-rental operation, so occasionally a true urgent renter, vehicle, or payment issue may happen outside regular working hours.



Are you reasonably willing to respond to an occasional urgent situation?



Please explain any limitations you would have.



17.



This position starts at:



$300 USD PER MONTH



Regardless of previous experience, every new person must learn our company’s systems and procedures.



Do you accept the $300 USD/month starting compensation, and do you understand that increases are not automatic or guaranteed but depend on performance, responsibility, business needs, and your growth within the company?



Please explain your understanding in your own words.



⸻



MAGIC WORD

To prove that you read this entire job posting, the FIRST LINE of your application must say:



CHEESE OMELETT



If CHEESE OMELETT is not the first line of your application, your application will not be considered.



⸻



 HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



* CHEESE OMELETT as the first line of your application

* Your current resume

* Your video introduction answering all 17 questions

* Confirmation that you accept the $300 USD/month starting compensation

* Confirmation that you can work Thursday–Monday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Central Time

* Confirmation that you understand Tuesday and Wednesday are your regular days off

* Confirmation that you understand the brief evening payment-check responsibility

* Confirmation that you understand the occasional urgent-situation expectation



Incomplete applications may not be reviewed.



We are looking for someone we can:



TRAIN • TRUST • DEVELOP • KEEP LONG-TERM



If you are dependable, friendly, highly trainable, comfortable speaking with customers, good at remembering processes, willing to take ownership, and excited about growing with a company, we would love to review your application.

title: Social Media Growth + Content Creator
description:
I'm building a portfolio of consumer apps and a growing media presence. I need one reliable full-time person to handle outreach to creators and help turn my recordings into content that gets people to the apps.



The Pitch



$150 - $200/month, paid on time every month

Performance bonuses tied to installs, signups, or creator deals closed

Raises after 90 days if goals are met

Relaxed work-life balance as long as targets are hit

Real ownership. You're not a cog, you'll shape how these apps get marketed.

Creative input is welcome. If you have ideas for hooks, formats, or campaigns, I want to hear them.



This is a good fit if you want to grow with early-stage products and take on more responsibility as they scale.



What You'll Do



Influencer and creator outreach



Find creators on
/X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube whose audiences fit each app

Send personalized cold outreach (DMs and
) and follow up

Negotiate simple deals: free access, affiliate arrangements, flat-fee posts, or shoutouts

Keep a tracker of creators contacted, replies, deals, and results

Report weekly on what's working



Content creation



Come up with content ideas for each app: short-form videos, posts, threads, and demos

Produce content yourself when needed (screen recordings, talking-head clips, UGC-style videos, graphics)

Edit recordings I send you into short-form clips (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) with captions, hooks, and clean pacing

Repurpose one piece of content across all four platforms

Post and schedule content, and engage with comments and DMs



What I'm Looking For



Proven experience doing creator or influencer outreach, or growing social accounts. Please share examples.

Strong written English. Your DMs and
s are the first impression of my brand.

Comfort with video editing in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar

A good feel for what performs on TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and X

Self-starter who can work from a loose brief without hand-holding

Reliable and communicative. Hitting deadlines matters more than fancy effects.

Available [timezone/hours overlap, e.g. 4+ hours overlapping with US Eastern]

Bonus: experience marketing apps or software, basic design skills (Canva/Figma), familiarity with analytics tools, or experience building simple landing pages or no-code tools



To Apply



Please include in your application:



Examples of outreach campaigns or accounts you've grown, with results if you have them

2-3 video samples you've edited or created

Your favorite app or product marketing campaign and why it worked

Your expected monthly salary and availability



Put "Growth + Content" in your subject line and
 
 applicants will complete a short paid test task: write 5 sample outreach messages and edit one 30-second clip.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

title: DM IG Appointment Setter (Online Women's Fitness Coaching)
description:
APPOINTMENT SETTER: WOMEN'S FAT LOSS COACHING (INSTAGRAM)

Base pay + uncapped commission + real growth path



We're an Australian online coaching business helping busy professional women lose weight sustainably. We're growing fast and hiring an experienced, reliable appointment setter to run our Instagram DMs and book qualified women onto sales calls.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We don't want someone who just clocks in. We want someone hungry, who owns their numbers and takes pride in driving the business forward. Our goal is to become one of the leading online coaching businesses in Australia, and our setter is at the heart of getting there. Help us get there, and you will be rewarded very well for the part you play.



REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- At least 6 months appointment setting on a fitness business Instagram account. Female weight loss experience strongly preferred.

- Excellent written English. Your messages need to sound like a warm, friendly Australian woman, not a script. This will be tested.

- Available in Melbourne time (currently GMT+11, GMT+10 from April): weekday shifts between 11am and 10pm (may be split), plus a few hours on both Saturday and Sunday.

- Stable internet with a backup (mobile data or pocket wifi) and backup power. Losing connection is not a reason to miss a shift.

- A VPN you can use.



THE ROLE

- Personalised outbound messages to new followers and past leads using our framework.

- Qualifying leads properly before offering a call. Our clients are professional women with demanding careers who are ready to commit to a 6 month program. Not everyone who says the right things is a fit.

- Booking calls, following up, and keeping our tracking up to date.

- Daily end-of-shift reports.

- Every message you send is written by you, not AI.



TRAINING AND SUPPORT

You'll be fully trained in our messaging framework, scripts and process, and you'll work closely with the founder from day one. Expect regular conversation reviews, direct feedback and daily check-ins. We invest heavily in our setters, and we expect you to take that training and run with it.



OUR STANDARDS

We hold very high standards, and we're upfront about them:

- You are reliable and on time, every shift. If you can't make a shift or will be late, you tell us BEFORE it starts, not after.

- You follow our process. Every lead, every shift.

- You own your numbers. If they're down, you work out why and fix it before we have to ask.

- You take responsibility for getting better. You review your own conversations, ask for feedback, and learn fast.

- You don't wait to be told what to do. We don't babysit. We want someone who owns this role.



If you're not willing to put in the work and become the best at what you do, this is not the role for you. Repeated lateness, missed shifts without notice, or not following the process will end the role.



THE TRIAL

We will trial two setters for 2 to 4 weeks (paid) and keep the strongest performer. You'll be assessed on reliability, judgment, volume and conversation quality.



PAY

- $6 USD/hour during the paid trial.

- Commission on every lead you book who pays and starts with us, with no cap.

- 40 to 50 hours per week once the trial is complete.

- This is a long term, full time role with permanent work for the right person. Strong performers will be rewarded with pay increases, higher commission and leadership opportunities as we grow.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Start your application with the words "EVOLVE SETTER". Applications without this will not be read.



In your application, include:

1. How long you've set for fitness businesses, and which niches.

2. A Google Drive link (set to "anyone with the link can view") containing as many examples of your work as possible: screenshots of real DM conversations from start to booking, including ones that didn't book (hide names and photos). The more you show us, the better. Minimum 5.

3. One reference from a previous fitness business you've set for.

4. Answer all three scenarios, in your own words:



   A) A lead says: "Sounds great, I'd love some help! I'm on holiday with the kids at the moment, back home next week." What's your next message, and would you send a booking link? Why or why not?



   B) A lead says she's keen to start, but has mentioned twice that money is tight, and that she's travelling overseas for 4 months from January. Our program is a 6 month minimum. What do you do?



   C) Yesterday a lead agreed she wanted help, said yes to a call, and you sent her the booking link. She hasn't booked and hasn't replied since. Write the exact message you'd send her today, and explain what you'd do if she still doesn't reply.

description:

Please check out our company directly on Google to see if you would be a fit and connect direct. We combine professional yoga instruction with the scientifically proven mental health benefits of animal therapy to deliver unique, morale-boosting events. title: Outbound Sales & Business Development Manager
description:
Outbound Business Development Manager



$1,200–$1,500 USD/month base + uncapped performance bonuses | ~$2,000/month OTE



We are an established Amazon agency looking for someone to fully own our outbound business development program from end to end.



This is not a basic lead generation or appointment-setting role.



We currently use an outside agency to manage outbound for us. It has successfully generated new clients, so we know the channel works. We now want to bring the entire function in-house so we have more control over our targeting, messaging, systems, testing, and quality.



We have a large team in the Philippines and are very comfortable working with remote team members. We're looking for someone who can take ownership of this function and grow it over time.



What You Will Own



You will be responsible for the entire outbound system, including both the technical infrastructure and day-to-day execution.



Outbound Infrastructure



You should be able to build and manage the technical stack yourself, including:



Selecting and setting up the outbound technology stack



Purchasing and configuring domains and mailboxes



Setting up and managing DNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up, and
 deliverability



Managing sending infrastructure and inbox health



Setting up and managing tools such as Clay, Apollo, Smartlead, Instantly, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar platforms



Building automations between prospecting, enrichment, outreach, replies, and our CRM/calendar



Troubleshooting technical and deliverability issues when they arise



We don't want someone who has only operated a system someone else built. You need to understand how to build and manage the system yourself.



Finding & Qualifying Prospects



You will:



Build large, targeted lists of Amazon sellers and DTC/ecommerce brands



Identify the correct founders, owners, executives, and ecommerce/Amazon decision-makers



Find and verify valid contact information



Enrich leads using multiple data sources



Qualify and segment companies based on relevant signals



Use signals such as Amazon presence, estimated sales, product category, company size, DTC presence, and other available data



Continuously improve our ideal customer profile based on actual campaign results



We want to reach the right companies and the right people, not simply send as many
s as possible.



Personalized Outreach



You will build and operate our outbound campaigns, including:



Writing cold
 sequences



Creating personalized outreach at scale



Using enrichment and AI intelligently to improve personalization



Creating and managing follow-up sequences



Testing different offers, audiences, subject lines, messaging, and approaches



Monitoring campaign performance and continuously improving it



We care a lot about quality.



Messages should sound like they came from a real person who actually looked at the company.



We do not want generic or obviously AI-generated outreach.



AI can absolutely be used as part of the process, but it should make the outreach better, not replace thinking.



Reply Management & Meeting Booking



You will also own what happens after someone responds.



That includes:



Monitoring replies



Responding quickly and naturally



Answering basic questions about our agency and offer



Following up with interested prospects



Qualifying opportunities



Handling objections



Booking qualified meetings directly onto our calendar



Depending on your experience, this role could eventually include short initial screening/qualification calls before scheduling meetings with our team.



Testing & Reporting



You should think about this as a growth channel, not simply a list of tasks to complete.



You'll track things such as:



Prospects contacted



Deliverability



Reply rates



Positive response rates



Qualified meetings booked



Qualified meetings held



Clients signed



Performance by audience, offer, campaign, and message



We want someone constantly asking:



What's working? What's not working? Why? What should we test next?



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone with meaningful experience in B2B outbound, cold
, lead generation, or business development.



More importantly, you should have direct experience building outbound systems yourself.



Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, Smartlead, Instantly, LinkedIn Sales Navigator,
 verification/enrichment tools, CRMs, and automation tools is highly preferred.



You should be:



An excellent written and spoken English communicator



Technically capable



Very comfortable with cold
 infrastructure



Strong at online research



Able to write concise, natural outreach



Comfortable communicating directly with prospects



Data-driven



Comfortable experimenting and testing



Highly organized



Able to work independently



Comfortable using AI without relying on generic AI-generated messages



Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions



Amazon or ecommerce experience is a major plus, but it is not required.



We would rather hire someone who is excellent at outbound and teach them more about Amazon than hire someone who understands Amazon but doesn't know how to build an outbound engine.



Compensation



Base salary: $1,200–$1,500 USD/month depending on experience



In addition to base salary, this position includes uncapped performance bonuses based on qualified meetings generated and new clients signed.



Our target compensation for someone performing well is approximately:



$2,000 USD/month OTE (base + bonuses). Strong performance can result in compensation above $2,000/month.



The exact starting base within the range will depend on experience. Someone who can demonstrate that they have personally built and managed successful outbound infrastructure will be toward the top of the range.



This is intended to be a long-term position. As the outbound program grows and you demonstrate results, there will be opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation.





How to Apply



A video application is required for this position.



Please record a 3-5 minute Loom or similar video introducing yourself and answering the questions below.



Please do not read from a prepared script or an AI-generated response. We're not evaluating your video production skills, and the video does not need to be polished.



We want to hear you explain your experience and thinking naturally, in your own words.



Part of this role involves communicating directly with prospects, so strong spoken English and the ability to think and communicate clearly are important.



In your video, please answer:



Tell us about an outbound cold
 system you personally built. What did you own versus what was handled by someone else?



Walk us through the technology stack you used. What did you use for lead sourcing, enrichment,
 verification, domains/mailboxes, sending, deliverability, automation, and reply management?



Imagine you started working with us tomorrow and we had nothing set up. How would you build our outbound system from scratch? Walk us through the process.



How would you find Amazon sellers and DTC/ecommerce brands for us to contact? What data sources and signals would you use to determine which companies are good prospects?



How would you personalize thousands of cold
s without making them sound generic or obviously AI-generated?



Tell us about an outbound campaign you've personally managed. Roughly how many prospects did you contact? How many positive responses and qualified meetings did it generate? What worked and what didn't?



Please include the video link with your application along with a short written introduction.



Applications without a video will not be considered.

title: Automotive Operations Coordinator
description:
Automotive Operations & Dispatch Coordinator

-We’re hiring a high-performing, detail-obsessed Operations Coordinator to help us run and grow a mobile automotive shop in Austin, Texas — a premium mobile tire and oil change business serving performance car owners and select fleets in the Austin metro area.

This is a hybrid customer-facing and backend operations role. You’ll be responsible for making sure the daily work gets done accurately, efficiently, and on time — coordinating jobs, processing approvals, managing tech schedules, tracking AR, and keeping our customers in the loop.

You’ll also assist with light marketing coordination (e.g., newsletter support, gathering photos from the team) — just a few hours weekly.



Key Responsibilities

1. Fleet & Retail Ops Coordination

--Create and submit estimates

--Follow up for approval

--Ensure parts are sourced

--Finalize tech routes for the following day

5. Marketing & Content Support 

--Publish our monthly newsletter in MailChimp with content from marketing team

 / Google My Business

What Success Looks Like

-You identify blockers or problems before they become fires

-Communication is clear, timely, and professional — with both customers and internal team

-The business runs like a machine — nothing gets missed or delayed

-You take full ownership of your responsibilities and require very little follow-up

-A natural systems thinker who thrives on clarity, organization, and ownership

-Extremely proactive — you don’t wait to be told what to do

-Excellent at written and verbal English communication

-Comfortable in the automotive world and eager to learn the details

-Sharp and reliable — you retain info, spot gaps, and follow through



Experience & Skills Required

-3+ years of experience in a remote automotive: coordinator, dispatcher, operations role

-Demonstrated responsibility for keeping things moving without handholding

-Excellent written and spoken English

-Experience with dispatch, route planning, or technician scheduling

-Familiar with tools like Slack, Google Docs, Trello (or similar), CRM/invoicing platforms

-Experience working with U.S.-based field service, auto, or fleet companies

-Bonus: Familiarity with AutoIntegrate, Housecall Pro, Element, or LeasePlan platforms



Required Software Experience

-Slack

-WhatsApp

-Trello (or similar)

-Google Workspace

-CRM / invoicing tools (Housecall Pro, AutoIntegrate)


 (plus)



TECH REQUIREMENTS:

-Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

title: Crypto BD Lead: $100 Per Qualified Call + Uncapped Partnership Revenue (Player-Coach)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS .

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.
